promises.text: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”

promises.promise: You are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, abundant in faithful love, and didn’t forsake them.
promises.text: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.

promises.promise: In your manifold mercies you didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar didn’t depart. Forty years you sustained them—they lacked nothing.
promises.text: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go. You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst. “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

promises.promise: God promises that naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked he will return there. the Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away. Blessed be God's name.
promises.text: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the LORD’s name.”

promises.promise: Happy is the one God corrects. Do not despise his training—he wounds, but he also binds up; his hands make whole.
promises.text: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty. For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

promises.promise: God promises he will not cast away a blameless man; he will yet fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with shouting.
promises.text: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers. He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

promises.promise: If you set your heart right and reach out to God, you will lift your face without shame. You will be steady and not afraid.
promises.text: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him. If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents. Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

promises.promise: Who doesn’t know that God's hand has done this, in whose hand is the life of every living thing and the breath of all mankind?
promises.text: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this, in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

promises.promise: God promises that he will kill me. he has no hope. Nevertheless, he will maintain his ways before him.
promises.text: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

promises.promise: God promises that if a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my warfare I wait until my release comes. You will call, and he will answer; you will long for the work of your hands.
promises.text: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come. You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

promises.promise: Even now, your witness is in heaven. The one who speaks for you is on high.
promises.text: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

promises.promise: God promises that i know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end he will stand on the earth; after my skin is destroyed, then in my flesh he will see God.
promises.text: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth. After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh, whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

promises.promise: Get to know God now and be at peace—good will come. Return to the Almighty, and you will be built up.
promises.text: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you. Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart. If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

promises.promise: God promises that but he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, he will come out like gold.
promises.text: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

promises.promise: But he stands alone. Who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does. For he performs that which is appointed for me.
promises.text: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does. For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

promises.promise: God promises that he sings before men: he has sinned; he has redeemed my soul from going into the pit; my life will see the light.
promises.text: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me. He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

promises.promise: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne he sets them forever. They are exalted.
promises.text: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

promises.promise: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ear in oppression. Yes, he would have allured you out of distress into a broad place where there is no constraint.
promises.text: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression. Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

promises.promise: God promises that i know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
promises.text: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

promises.promise: the Lord restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.
promises.text: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

promises.promise: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning—sheep, camels, oxen, and donkeys in abundance.
promises.text: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

promises.promise: God blesses the one who delights in his law with rooted stability and growth.
promises.text: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers; but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night. He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
promises.context: Opening psalm contrasting the righteous and the wicked.

promises.promise: the Lord declares his Son and promises the nations as his inheritance.
promises.text: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father. Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

promises.promise: God is a shield and the lifter of the head. He answers from his holy hill.
promises.text: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head. I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

promises.promise: God holds you through the night. You wake because he sustains you—so you need not fear the crowds around you.
promises.text: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me. I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

promises.promise: the Lord sets apart the godly for himself and hears when they call.
promises.text: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.

promises.promise: God alone can keep you safe. He gives peaceful sleep to those who trust him.
promises.text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

promises.promise: God spreads his protection over those who love him. He surrounds his people with favor like a shield.
promises.text: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you. For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

promises.promise: The God of heaven crowns fragile people with glory and honor, and gives them a place of care over creation.
promises.text: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained, what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him? For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

promises.promise: the Lord is a refuge for the oppressed and does not forsake those who seek him.
promises.text: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble. Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

promises.promise: God will not forever forget the needy. The hope of the poor will not perish.
promises.text: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

promises.promise: God promises that he hears the desire of the humble, strengthens their heart, and does justice for the orphan and oppressed.
promises.text: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear, to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

promises.promise: In the Lord one takes refuge—even when the urge is to flee like a bird to the mountain.
promises.text: In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

promises.promise: the Lord arises to protect the poor and needy from those who malign them.
promises.text: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

promises.promise: God is in the generation of the righteous. He is the refuge of the poor despite the wicked’s scorn.
promises.text: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous. You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

promises.promise: With God at your right hand, you can stand firm. In his presence there is joy and the path of life.
promises.text: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety. For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption. You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

promises.promise: God promises to keep his own as the apple of his eye and hides them under his wings.
promises.text: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

promises.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.
promises.text: I love you, LORD, my strength. The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower. I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
promises.context: David’s song after God rescued him from Saul.

promises.promise: God’s way is perfect, and his word proves true. He is a shield to everyone who takes refuge in him.
promises.text: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
promises.context: A quiet thought about who God is.

promises.promise: God's law is perfect, restoring the soul; his teachings rejoice the heart and warn; in keeping them there is great reward.
promises.text: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple. The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes. The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether. They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb. Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
promises.context: A song about how good God’s teaching is.

promises.promise: the Lord saves his chosen one and answers from heaven with saving strength—trust not chariots but God's name.
promises.text: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand. Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
promises.context: A prayer asking God for help before a battle.

promises.promise: God has not despised the afflicted’s suffering, nor hidden his face; when they cried, he heard.
promises.text: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

promises.promise: The humble eat and are satisfied; seekers praise the Lord; all families of nations will worship.
promises.text: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever. All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

promises.promise: God is your shepherd—you lack nothing. He leads you to rest and peace, restores your soul, and walks with you even through the darkest valley.
promises.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake. Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
promises.context: David’s psalm of trust in the Lord as shepherd.

promises.promise: God prepares a table, anoints with oil. He also pursues with goodness all one’s days into his house forever.
promises.text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over. Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

promises.promise: The clean of hands and pure of heart receive blessing from the Lord and righteousness from the God of salvation.
promises.text: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place? He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully. He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

promises.promise: God instructs sinners in the way; his paths are faithful love and truth for lasting promise keepers.
promises.text: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way. He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way. All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

promises.promise: The friendship of the Lord is with those who fear him; he shows them his lasting promise.
promises.text: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

promises.promise: the Lord is light and salvation—reason not to fear; he is the stronghold of life.
promises.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

promises.promise: God hides you when you seek him in his safe shelter and sets them on a rock in the day of trouble.
promises.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple. For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

promises.promise: Even if father and mother forsake, the Lord will take up his own.
promises.text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

promises.promise: Belief in seeing God's goodness in the land of the living; wait for the Lord with strength.
promises.text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living. Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

promises.promise: God promises that he hears the cry for mercy; he is strength and shield, and the heart trusts and exults.
promises.text: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions. The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

promises.promise: the Lord is strength to his people and saving refuge of his chosen one; he shepherds and carries them forever.
promises.text: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed. Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

promises.promise: the Lord gives strength to his people and blesses them with peace.
promises.text: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.
promises.context: Voice of the Lord over the waters.

promises.promise: God’s anger lasts a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
promises.text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

promises.promise: You can place your life in God’s hands. He is the faithful God who redeems.
promises.text: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.

promises.promise: God stores up great goodness for those who honor him. He hides you in the shelter of his presence.
promises.text: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men! In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

promises.promise: Love the Lord; he preserves the faithful. Be strong and take heart, all who hope in the Lord.
promises.text: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly. Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

promises.promise: Blessed is the one whose wrong is forgiven and whose sin is covered; no deceit in the spirit.
promises.text: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered. Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

promises.promise: God is hiding place and surrounding songs of deliverance. He promises to instruct and counsel with his eye.
promises.text: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah. I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

promises.promise: God's word is right; his work is done in faithfulness; he loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of his faithful love.
promises.text: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness. He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

promises.promise: God's eye is on those who fear him and hope in his faithful love—to deliver from death and keep alive in famine.
promises.text: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness, to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine. Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield. For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name. Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.

promises.promise: Those who seek the Lord are delivered from fears; the angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him.
promises.text: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears. They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame. This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles. The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

promises.promise: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.
promises.text: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

promises.promise: God's eyes and ears are toward the righteous; he is near the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit.
promises.text: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry. The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth. The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles. The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

promises.promise: Many afflictions meet the righteous, but the Lord delivers; he redeems his servants; none who take refuge are condemned.
promises.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all. He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken. Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned. The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

promises.promise: The soul will rejoice in the Lord and delight in his salvation—who is like God, delivering the poor from those too strong.
promises.text: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation. All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

promises.promise: God’s faithful love reaches heaven; with him is the fountain of life, and in his light we see light.
promises.text: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies. Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal. How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings. They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures. For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

promises.promise: Trust, do good, delight in the Lord—he gives the desires of the heart and brings forth righteousness like light.
promises.text: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture. Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart. Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

promises.promise: Rest in the Lord and wait patiently; refuse fretting and anger that only leads to evil.
promises.text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen. Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

promises.promise: A person’s steps are established by the Lord; though they stumble, they will not be utterly cast down, for God upholds.
promises.text: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way. Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

promises.promise: The righteous are not forsaken. Their children are not begging bread. They lend generously and their seed is blessed.
promises.text: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread. All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

promises.promise: The salvation of the righteous is from the Lord; he is their stronghold in trouble and delivers them.
promises.text: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble. The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

promises.promise: Lord, what am I waiting for? My hope is in you.
promises.text: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

promises.promise: God promises that he hears the cry, lifts from the pit, sets feet on rock, and puts a new song in the mouth.
promises.text: I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand. He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

promises.promise: Do not withhold tender mercies; let faithful love and truth continually preserve.
promises.text: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

promises.promise: God delivers, protects, and sustains the one who cares for the poor—even on a sickbed.
promises.text: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil. The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies. The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

promises.promise: Even when your soul feels cast down, put your hope in God. Praise him for the help of his presence.
promises.text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

promises.promise: By day the Lord commands his faithful love; by night his song is with his people in prayer.
promises.text: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

promises.promise: Send out light and truth to lead to God’s holy hill; hope in God—yet praise him, the help of your countenance.
promises.text: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents. Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God. Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

promises.promise: Not bow or sword saves. God saves from adversaries; in God the people boast all day and give thanks forever.
promises.text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me. But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us. In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

promises.promise: God is your refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Even if the earth shakes, you can find safety in him.
promises.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas; though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
promises.context: God is present with his people as their refuge.

promises.promise: Be still and know that he is God; the Lord of Armies is with his people as their fortress.
promises.text: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.” The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

promises.promise: God reigns over the nations; the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted.
promises.text: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne. The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

promises.promise: This God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to the end.
promises.text: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

promises.promise: God promises he will redeem the soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.
promises.text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

promises.promise: Call on God in the day of trouble. He will rescue you—and you can praise him for it.
promises.text: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

promises.promise: God can cleanse, wash whiter than snow, restore joy of salvation. He also uphold with a willing spirit.
promises.text: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow. Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice. Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities. Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me. Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me. Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

promises.promise: Like a green olive tree in God’s house, trust in his faithful love forever; praise and wait on his name.
promises.text: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever. I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

promises.promise: God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
promises.text: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

promises.promise: Cast your burden on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never allow the righteous to be moved.
promises.text: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

promises.promise: When you are afraid, trust in God. Praise his word—people cannot ultimately harm what he holds.
promises.text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

promises.promise: God counts wanderings and puts tears in his bottle. They are in his book.
promises.text: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

promises.promise: Take refuge in the shadow of God’s wings until the danger has passed.
promises.text: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

promises.promise: Cry to God Most High who fulfills his purpose; he sends from heaven and saves, sending faithful love and truth.
promises.text: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me. He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

promises.promise: God is the strength; the God of faithful love will meet me; God will let me look on foes in triumph.
promises.text: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower. My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

promises.promise: Give victory, for human help alone is not enough; through God we will act with courage; he will defeat our enemies.
promises.text: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain. Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

promises.promise: God leads to the rock higher than yourself and lets people in need dwell in his tent forever.
promises.text: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer. From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I. For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy. I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
promises.context: Cry from the end of the earth.

promises.promise: Let your soul wait quietly for God alone. He is your saving help, your rock, and your fortress—you will not be deeply shaken.
promises.text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him. He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

promises.promise: Wait for God alone. Pour out your heart before him—he is a refuge for you.
promises.text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him. He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken. My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God. Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

promises.promise: God’s faithful love is better than life; lips praise him in the longing desert.
promises.text: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water. So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory. Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you. So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

promises.promise: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord and take refuge in him; all the upright in heart shall glory.
promises.text: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

promises.promise: God hears prayer, atones for wrongs, and satisfies with the goodness of his house.
promises.text: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you. You who hear prayer, all men will come to you. Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions. Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

promises.promise: Bless God—he holds your life in his hands and does not let your feet slip.
promises.text: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard, who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

promises.promise: Come hear what God has done; he heard the voice of prayer and did not reject faithful love or prayer.
promises.text: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul. I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue. If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened. But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer. Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

promises.promise: God be merciful. Bless us and cause his face to shine—so that his way may be known on earth, salvation among nations.
promises.text: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah. That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

promises.promise: God is father of the fatherless and defender of widows. He sets the lonely in families and frees prisoners.
promises.text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation. God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

promises.promise: God bears his people’s burdens daily. He is the God of salvation to whom belong escapes from death.
promises.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah. God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

promises.promise: As for me, my prayer is to you, Lord, in an acceptable time; God, in the abundance of your faithful love, answer me in the truth of your salvation.
promises.text: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

promises.promise: The humble have seen it and are glad; seekers live—for the Lord hears the needy and does not despise his prisoners.
promises.text: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live. For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

promises.promise: Let all who seek you rejoice; let lovers of your salvation say continually, Let God be exalted. Yet hasten to help the poor and needy.
promises.text: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!” But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.

promises.promise: God is hope and trust from youth. He has been the support from birth.
promises.text: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth. I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

promises.promise: Hope continually and praise more and more. Tell of God’s righteousness and salvation all day.
promises.text: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise. My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure. I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

promises.promise: God who showed many troubles will revive again, bring up from the depths, increase greatness. He also comfort.
promises.text: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth. Increase my honor and comfort me again.

promises.promise: The righteous king delivers people in need when they cry, redeems from oppression and violence—their blood is precious.
promises.text: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper. He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy. He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

promises.promise: May the king’s name endure forever; all nations call him blessed; blessed be the Lord God who alone does wondrous things—fill the earth with his glory.
promises.text: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed. Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds. Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

promises.promise: God holds the right hand, guides with counsel. He also afterward receives to glory; he is the strength of the heart forever.
promises.text: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand. You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory. Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you. My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
promises.context: Asaph after envy of the wicked.

promises.promise: God promises that as for me, it is good to be near God; he has made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
promises.text: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

promises.promise: Remember God's deeds and wonders of old; your way is holy; what god is great like God?
promises.text: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old. I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings. Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God? You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

promises.promise: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
promises.text: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

promises.promise: Revive us, and we will call on your name; turn us again, Lord God of Armies; cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
promises.text: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name. Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

promises.promise: God says he is the Lord your God who brought you out of Egypt; open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
promises.text: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

promises.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are those whose strength is in God—pilgrims who go from strength to strength appearing before God in Zion.
promises.text: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage. Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings. They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

promises.promise: the Lord God is sun and shield; he gives grace and glory and withholds no good thing from the upright.
promises.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly. LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
promises.context: Better one day in courts than a thousand elsewhere.

promises.promise: God showed favor to the land, brought back captivity, forgave sin, and covered all sin—withdrew all wrath.
promises.text: LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob. You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah. You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

promises.promise: God speaks peace to his people; faithful love and truth meet; righteousness and peace kiss.
promises.text: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly. Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land. Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

promises.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.
promises.text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

promises.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.
promises.text: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

promises.promise: Of Zion it will be said, This one and that one were born in her; the Most High himself will establish her; the Lord counts when he registers the peoples: This one was born there.
promises.text: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her. The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

promises.promise: God’s faithful love and faithfulness endure; he made a lasting promise with David to establish his children forever.
promises.text: I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations. I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.” “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant, ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

promises.promise: God will not utterly take faithful love from David’s line nor allow his faithfulness to fail; he will not break his lasting promise.
promises.text: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail. I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

promises.promise: Lord, you have been our home through all generations. From everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
promises.text: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations. Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

promises.promise: Teach us to number our days, so we may gain a wise heart.
promises.text: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

promises.promise: Satisfy us in the morning with your faithful love, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
promises.text: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

promises.promise: Dwelling in God’s secret place means rest under Shaddai’s shadow. Refuge, fortress, wings, and faithfulness as shield.
promises.text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.” For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence. He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

promises.promise: No fear of night terror or day’s arrow; God deals with scourge and plague while those who trust him look on in safety.
promises.text: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day, nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday. A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you. You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

promises.promise: Because the Lord is refuge, no evil will conquer; angels guard in all ways; the faithful tread lion and serpent.
promises.text: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place, no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling. For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways. They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone. You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

promises.promise: God promises deliverance, exaltation, answered prayer, long life. He also shown salvation to the one who loves and knows his name.
promises.text: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name. He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him. I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

promises.promise: It is good to give thanks to the Lord and to sing praises—to declare faithful love in the morning and faithfulness at night.
promises.text: It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High, to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

promises.promise: The righteous flourish like a palm and grow like a cedar—still fruitful in old age, declaring the Lord is upright.
promises.text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon. They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts. They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green, to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

promises.promise: Blessed is the one you discipline, Lord—taught from your law—to give rest from days of adversity until a pit is dug for the wicked.
promises.text: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law, that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

promises.promise: the Lord will not reject his people nor forsake his inheritance; judgment will return to righteousness.
promises.text: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance. For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

promises.promise: When the foot slips, God’s faithful love holds up; when anxieties multiply within, his comforts delight the soul.
promises.text: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up. In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

promises.promise: Let heavens and earth rejoice. For he comes to judge the earth; he will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with his truth.
promises.text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

promises.promise: God preserves the souls of his saints. Delivers from the wicked; light is sown for the righteous and gladness for the upright.
promises.text: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked. Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

promises.promise: Sing a new song—he has done marvelous things; his right hand and holy arm have worked salvation; he has remembered faithful love and faithfulness to Israel; all ends of the earth have seen God’s salvation.
promises.text: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him. The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations. He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

promises.promise: You answered them, Lord our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
promises.text: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

promises.promise: the Lord is good; his faithful love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.
promises.text: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

promises.promise: God regards the prayer of the destitute; he looks down to hear the groaning of the prisoner. Release those appointed to death.
promises.text: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer. This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD, for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth, to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

promises.promise: God laid earth’s foundation; heavens wear out but God remains; the children of his servants will continue, and their children will be established before him.
promises.text: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands. They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed. But you are the same. Your years will have no end. The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

promises.promise: God forgives sin, heals diseases, redeems from the pit, crowns with faithful love, and satisfies with good so youth is renewed.
promises.text: Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name! Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits, who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases, who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies, who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

promises.promise: the Lord is merciful and gracious; he has not dealt with us according to sins—as far as east from west, he removes wrongs.
promises.text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness. He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever. He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities. For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him. As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

promises.promise: As a father has compassion on children, the Lord has compassion on those who fear him—he knows our frame, that we are dust.
promises.text: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him. For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

promises.promise: God's faithful love is from everlasting to everlasting on those who fear him, and his righteousness to children’s children.
promises.text: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children, to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

promises.promise: God remembers his lasting promise forever—the word he commanded to a thousand generations—the lasting promise with Abraham, the oath to Isaac, confirmed to Jacob as a statute: to you he will give the land of Canaan.
promises.text: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations, the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac, and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant, saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

promises.promise: Nevertheless he regarded their distress when he heard their cry; he remembered his lasting promise and relented according to his faithful love; he made them objects of compassion before captors.
promises.text: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry. He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses. He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

promises.promise: Give thanks—his faithful love endures forever; let the redeemed say so, whom he redeemed from the hand of the adversary.
promises.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

promises.promise: They cried to the Lord in trouble; he saved them, brought them out of darkness and broke their bonds.
promises.text: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses. He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains. Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men! For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

promises.promise: They cry in their trouble. He saves them and sends his word to heal them and deliver from destruction.
promises.text: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses. He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
promises.context: Sick from sin healed by God’s word.

promises.promise: Storm-tossed sailors cry out. God stills the storm to a whisper and brings them to their desired haven.
promises.text: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress. He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still. Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

promises.promise: Give us help against the adversary, for human help alone is not enough; through God we will act with courage.
promises.text: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain. Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

promises.promise: the Lord says to my Lord, Sit at my right hand; you are a priest forever after Melchizedek’s order.
promises.text: The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.” The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies. Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth. The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

promises.promise: God has given food to those who fear him; he always remembers his lasting promise.
promises.text: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

promises.promise: He has sent redemption to his people; he has commanded his lasting promise forever—holy and awesome is his name. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
promises.text: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome! The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

promises.promise: Blessed is the one who fears the Lord; their descendants are mighty; light dawns in darkness for the upright—gracious and merciful.
promises.text: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments. His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed. Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever. Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

promises.promise: God raises the poor from the dust. Lifts the needy from the ash heap to seat them with princes; he settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother.
promises.text: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap, that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people. He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!

promises.promise: Trust in the Lord—he is help and shield; he will bless those who fear him, small and great.
promises.text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield. The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron. He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.

promises.promise: God hears the voice of supplication, deals bountifully, and delivers soul from death—walk before the Lord in the land of the living.
promises.text: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy. Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live. The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow. Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.” The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful. The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me. Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you. For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling. I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

promises.promise: Precious in God's sight is the death of his saints.
promises.text: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.
promises.context: Costly care for his people’s lives.

promises.promise: God promises that out of distress I called; the Lord answered and set me in a large place. the Lord is on my side—he will not fear.
promises.text: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom. The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

promises.promise: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in humans or princes.
promises.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man. It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.

promises.promise: God promises that the Lord is strength and song and has become salvation; he will not die but live and declare his works.
promises.text: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly. The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!” I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.

promises.promise: The stone the builders rejected becomes the cornerstone—this is God's doing; this is the day the Lord has made; rejoice.
promises.text: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

promises.promise: A young person cleanses their way by taking heed according to God’s word. Hiding the word in the heart guards from sin.
promises.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word. With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments. I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

promises.promise: My soul is weary with sorrow. Strengthen me according to your word.
promises.text: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

promises.promise: Remember your word to your servant, Lord—because your promise gave me hope.
promises.text: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

promises.promise: God’s promise gives life and is comfort in suffering.
promises.text: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

promises.promise: Before affliction I went astray, but now I observe your word. You are good, and do good; teach me your ways.
promises.text: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word. You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

promises.promise: God promises that it is good for me that he has been afflicted, that I may learn your ways; the law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.
promises.text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes. The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

promises.promise: Please let your faithful love be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
promises.text: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

promises.promise: God’s word is a lamp for your feet and a light for your path.
promises.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

promises.promise: God is hiding place and shield. His people hope in his word.
promises.text: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

promises.promise: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
promises.text: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

promises.promise: Great peace have people who love God’s law; nothing causes them to stumble.
promises.text: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

promises.promise: In my distress I cried to the Lord, and he answered me.
promises.text: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

promises.promise: Help comes from the Lord, maker of heaven and earth—he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
promises.text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth. He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber. Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

promises.promise: the Lord is keeper and shade; he preserves from all evil and keeps going out and coming in forever.
promises.text: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand. The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night. The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul. The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

promises.promise: Blessed be the Lord who has not given us as prey; our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
promises.text: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth. Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped. Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.
promises.context: If the Lord had not been on our side.

promises.promise: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved; as mountains surround Jerusalem, the Lord surrounds his people from this time forward and forever.
promises.text: Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever. As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

promises.promise: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy; anyone who goes forth weeping returns with sheaves of joy.
promises.text: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy. He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

promises.promise: Unless the Lord builds the house, builders labor in vain; he gives sleep to his beloved.
promises.text: Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain. It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
promises.context: Pilgrim wisdom on work and family.

promises.promise: Children are a heritage from the Lord; the fruit of the womb is his reward—blessed is the man with a quiver full.
promises.text: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward. As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth. Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

promises.promise: Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord; you will eat the labor of your hands; your wife like a fruitful vine, children like olive plants—thus is the man blessed who fears the Lord.
promises.text: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways. For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you. Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table. Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

promises.promise: Out of the depths I cry to you, Lord; Lord, hear my voice; let your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.
promises.text: Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD. Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

promises.promise: If God marked sins, none could stand—but with him there is forgiveness; wait for the Lord and in his word hope.
promises.text: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand? But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared. I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

promises.promise: Hope in the Lord—with him is faithful love and abundant redemption; he will redeem Israel from all sin.
promises.text: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him. He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

promises.promise: God promises that o Lord, my heart is not haughty; he has stilled and quieted my soul like a weaned child—hope in the Lord from this time forth and forever.
promises.text: LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me. Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me. Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.

promises.promise: God promises that the Lord swore to David in truth: he will set on your throne the fruit of your body—if your children keep his lasting promise, their children also forever.
promises.text: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne. If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

promises.promise: God promises that the Lord has chosen Zion; this is my resting place forever; he will abundantly bless her provision, satisfy her poor, clothe priests with salvation, and make saints shout for joy.
promises.text: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation. “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it. I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread. I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

promises.promise: How good and pleasant when brothers dwell together in unity—like oil on Aaron, like Hermon’s dew on Zion, where the Lord commanded the blessing, even life forever.
promises.text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity! It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes, like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.

promises.promise: Your name, Lord, endures forever; your renown throughout all generations. For the Lord will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
promises.text: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations. For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

promises.promise: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good—his faithful love endures forever; give thanks to the God of gods and Lord of lords—his faithful love endures forever.
promises.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever. Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

promises.promise: God says he will give thanks with my whole heart; by day I call and you answer and embolden me with strength in my soul.
promises.text: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you. I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all. In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

promises.promise: Though walking in trouble, God revives; he stretches out his hand against wrath; he will perfect what concerns his servant—his faithful love endures forever.
promises.text: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me. The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

promises.promise: God knows sitting and rising, thoughts from afar, paths and lying down. Such knowledge is too wonderful.
promises.text: LORD, you have searched me, and you know me. You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar. You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways. For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether. You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me. This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

promises.promise: No escape from God’s Spirit. In heaven, Sheol, or the far sea, his hand leads and holds; darkness is as light to him.
promises.text: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence? If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there! If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea, even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me. If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,” even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

promises.promise: God formed heart and knitted in the womb; all days were written in his book before one of them came to be.
promises.text: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb. I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well. My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth. Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

promises.promise: Search me, O God, know my heart. Lead me in the everlasting way.
promises.text: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

promises.promise: God promises that i know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted and justice for the needy; surely the righteous will give thanks; the upright will dwell in your presence.
promises.text: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy. Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

promises.promise: Hurry to me, Lord; give ear when I cry; let prayer be like incense, the lifting of hands like evening sacrifice.
promises.text: LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you. Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

promises.promise: God promises that i cry with my voice to the Lord; I pour out my complaint; when his spirit is overwhelmed, you know my path. You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.
promises.text: I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy. I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me. Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul. I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

promises.promise: Cause me to hear your faithful love in the morning; cause me to know the way I should walk; deliver me; teach me to do your will; let your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
promises.text: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you. Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me. Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

promises.promise: Blessed be the Lord my rock, who trains my hands for war; my faithful love, fortress, high tower, deliverer, shield, and the one in whom I take refuge.
promises.text: Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle— my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

promises.promise: Happy are the people who are in such a case; happy are the people whose God is the Lord.
