promises.text: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness. The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

promises.promise: God’s dominion endures. He upholds all who fall, raises all who are bowed down, and satisfies the desire of every living thing.
promises.text: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds. The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down. The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season. You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

promises.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.
promises.text: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works. The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth. He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them. The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

promises.promise: Happy is the one whose help is the God of Jacob. Keeper of truth forever, who executes justice for the oppressed, gives food to the hungry, frees prisoners, opens blind eyes, raises the bowed down, loves the righteous, preserves strangers, upholds orphan and widow.
promises.text: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God, who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever; who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners. The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous. The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

promises.promise: God heals the brokenhearted and gently binds up their wounds.
promises.text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

promises.promise: the Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his faithful love.
promises.text: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

promises.promise: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

promises.promise: God promises that turn at my reproof. he will pour out his spirit on you. he will make known my words to you.
promises.text: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

promises.promise: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely. Will be at ease, without fear of harm.
promises.text: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

promises.promise: the Lord gives wisdom; he stores sound knowledge; he is a shield to those who walk in integrity; he guards the paths of justice and preserves the way of his saints.
promises.text: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding. He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity, that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

promises.promise: Don’t forget my teaching; keep commandments. For length of days, years of life, and peace they will add to you.
promises.text: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments, for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

promises.promise: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
promises.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

promises.promise: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the Lord and depart from evil—it will be health to your body and nourishment to your bones.
promises.text: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil. It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

promises.promise: Honor the Lord with your substance and first fruits—your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats overflow with new wine.
promises.text: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase; so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

promises.promise: Don’t despise God's discipline; don’t be weary of his reproof—for whom the Lord loves, he reproves, as a father the son in whom he delights.
promises.text: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction; for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

promises.promise: Happy is the one who finds wisdom—more precious than silver. Long life in her right hand. In her left riches and honor.
promises.text: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding. For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold. She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her. Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor. Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace. She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

promises.promise: Keep sound wisdom; it will be life to your soul; then you will walk in your way securely; the Lord will be your confidence and keep your foot from being taken.
promises.text: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion, so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck. Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble. When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet. Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes; for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

promises.promise: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget. Wisdom is the principal thing. Therefore get wisdom. Yes, with all your getting, get understanding.
promises.text: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth. Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you. Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

promises.promise: The path of those who walk with God is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
promises.text: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

promises.promise: Attend to my words; keep them in your heart—for they are life to people who find them, and health to their whole body.
promises.text: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings. Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart. For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

promises.promise: Keep father’s commandment and mother’s teaching. For the commandment is a lamp, teaching is light, and reproofs of instruction are the way of life.
promises.text: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching. Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck. When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you. For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

promises.promise: God promises that i love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
promises.text: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

promises.promise: Listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways. Blessed is the one who listens; for whoever finds me finds life and will obtain favor from the Lord.
promises.text: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways. Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it. Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts. For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.

promises.promise: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding. For by me your days will be multiplied and years of life added.
promises.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding. For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

promises.promise: the Lord will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
promises.text: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

promises.promise: Hate stirs up conflict, but love covers wrongs.
promises.text: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

promises.promise: God's blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
promises.text: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

promises.promise: Pride brings shame, but humility brings wisdom.
promises.text: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

promises.promise: There is one who scatters and increases. The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters will also be watered himself.
promises.text: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty. The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

promises.promise: Worry weighs a heart down, but a kind word brings gladness.
promises.text: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

promises.promise: When hope is delayed, the heart grows sick—but a fulfilled longing is like a tree of life.
promises.text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

promises.promise: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence; his children will have a place of refuge. The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, turning from the snares of death.
promises.text: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children. The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

promises.promise: A gentle answer turns away anger, but a harsh word stirs it up.
promises.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

promises.promise: A glad heart shows on the face, but an aching heart can break the spirit.
promises.text: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

promises.promise: the Lord is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
promises.text: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

promises.promise: Commit your deeds to the Lord, and your plans shall succeed.
promises.text: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

promises.promise: When a man’s ways please the Lord, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
promises.text: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

promises.promise: A man’s heart plans his course, but the Lord directs his steps.
promises.text: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

promises.promise: The name of the Lord is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
promises.text: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

promises.promise: A brave spirit can carry you through sickness—but a crushed spirit is hard to bear.
promises.text: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

promises.promise: Many companions are not enough—but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
promises.text: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

promises.promise: God promises that anyone who has pity on the poor lends to the Lord; he will reward him.
promises.text: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

promises.promise: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but God's counsel will prevail.
promises.text: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

promises.promise: The fear of the Lord leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
promises.text: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

promises.promise: God promises that don’t say, he will pay back evil. Wait for the Lord, and he will save you.
promises.text: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

promises.promise: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit. Everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
promises.text: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

promises.promise: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord. The horse is prepared for battle, but victory belongs to the Lord.
promises.text: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD. The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.

promises.promise: The result of humility and the fear of the Lord is wealth, honor, and life.
promises.text: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.

promises.promise: Train up a child in the way he should go. When he is old he will not depart from it.
promises.text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

promises.promise: Eat honey. So is wisdom: when you find it, there will be a future; your hope will not be cut off.
promises.text: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste; so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.

promises.promise: Those who walk with God may fall seven times and still rise again—but trouble overthrows the wicked.
promises.text: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

promises.promise: God promises that anyone who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
promises.text: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

promises.promise: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the Lord is kept safe.
promises.text: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

promises.promise: Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to people who take refuge in him.
promises.text: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

promises.promise: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
promises.text: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

promises.promise: God promises that i know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.
promises.text: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

promises.promise: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it. This is the gift of God. He will not often remember the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.
promises.text: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God. For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

promises.promise: Fear God and keep his commandments. This is the whole duty of man. God will bring every work into judgment.
promises.text: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man. For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

promises.promise: God invites: though sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Reasoning together toward cleansing.
promises.text: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says the LORD: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
promises.context: Opening indictment turns to mercy offer.

promises.promise: In the latter days Zion is exalted. Nations stream to learn God’s ways. He judges and they beat swords into plowshares.
promises.text: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it. Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem. He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

promises.promise: Over Mount Zion God creates cloud by day and flaming fire by night. A canopy and refuge from heat and storm.
promises.text: The LORD will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy. There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.

promises.promise: A seraph touches the prophet’s lips with a coal from the altar: sin is taken away and sin forgiven.
promises.text: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar. He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

promises.promise: The Lord himself gives a sign: the virgin will conceive and bear a son, Immanuel. God with us.
promises.text: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

promises.promise: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light. On those in the land of the shadow of death, light has shined.
promises.text: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.

promises.promise: God promises a child is born for us—Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace—and his reign of peace will never end.
promises.text: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace. Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.

promises.promise: A remnant of Israel will return to the Mighty God and lean on the Lord in truth.
promises.text: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth. A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

promises.promise: A shoot from Jesse’s stump. Spirit-resting Messiah judges with righteousness and equity for the poor and meek.
promises.text: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit. The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD. His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears; but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked. Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.

promises.promise: Wolf dwells with lamb; earth is full of the knowledge of the Lord as waters cover the sea—no harm on God’s holy mountain.
promises.text: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them. The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

promises.promise: God’s anger turns away and he comforts; God is salvation—trust and not be afraid; the Lord is strength and song.
promises.text: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me. Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

promises.promise: With joy you will draw water out of the wells of saving help.
promises.text: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

promises.promise: the Lord will have compassion on Jacob and choose Israel again; strangers will join them.
promises.text: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob. The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

promises.promise: On this mountain the Lord prepares a feast for all peoples and swallows up death forever; he wipes tears from all faces.
promises.text: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines. He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations. He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.

promises.promise: God keeps in perfect peace those whose mind is stayed on him because they trust; trust in the Lord forever—everlasting Rock.
promises.text: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you. Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.

promises.promise: Lord, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
promises.text: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.

promises.promise: Your dead shall live; their bodies shall rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust. The earth will cast out the dead.
promises.text: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.

promises.promise: The Lord GOD lays in Zion a tried stone, precious cornerstone, sure foundation; anyone who believes will not be in haste.
promises.text: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.

promises.promise: In that day the deaf hear the words of the book. The blind see out of gloom. The humble and needy rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
promises.text: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness. The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

promises.promise: In returning and rest you will be saved. In quietness and trust will be your strength.
promises.text: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

promises.promise: Therefore the Lord will wait to be gracious; he is a God of justice—blessed are all who wait for him.
promises.text: Therefore the LORD will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for the LORD is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

promises.promise: A people in Zion will weep no more. He answers the cry. Teachers not hidden. Ears hear a word behind: This is the way, walk in it.
promises.text: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you. Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers; and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

promises.promise: A king reigns in righteousness. Each will be like a hiding place from wind, a covert from tempest, streams in dry place, shadow of a great rock.
promises.text: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice. A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.

promises.promise: The work of righteousness will be peace. The effect quietness and confidence forever. My people will live in peaceful habitations.
promises.text: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever. My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,

promises.promise: Lord, be gracious to us; we have waited for you. Be our arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
promises.text: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

promises.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.
promises.text: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness. There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure.

promises.promise: The wilderness and dry land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like the crocus—they will see the glory of the Lord.
promises.text: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose. It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the LORD’s glory, the excellence of our God.

promises.promise: Strengthen weak hands and feeble knees; say to the fearful: Be strong, don’t be afraid. Your God will come with vengeance and save you.
promises.text: Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm. Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong! Don’t be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.

promises.promise: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, ears of the deaf unstopped; the lame leap like a deer, and the mute sing. For waters break out in the wilderness.
promises.text: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped. Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

promises.promise: A highway of holiness—the redeemed walk there; the rescued of the Lord return to Zion with singing; everlasting joy on their heads; sorrow and sighing flee.
promises.text: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there. No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there. Then the LORD’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”

promises.promise: Lord, by these things people live. You restore me and make me live. You have loved my soul from the pit. You have cast all my sins behind your back.
promises.text: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live. Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.

promises.promise: Comfort, comfort my people—speak tenderly to Jerusalem; her warfare is accomplished; her sin pardoned.
promises.text: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God. “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.”

promises.promise: Every valley exalted, mountain made low; the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together.
promises.text: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain. The LORD’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it.”

promises.promise: Grass withers and flowers fade, but the word of our God stands forever.
promises.text: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

promises.promise: The Lord GOD comes as a mighty one. He gathers lambs in his arm, carries them in his bosom, and gently leads those with young.
promises.text: Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him. He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

promises.promise: The everlasting God does not faint; he gives power to the faint; those who wait for the Lord renew strength—mount up with wings like eagles, run and not be weary, walk and not faint.
promises.text: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable. He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might. Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall; but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

promises.promise: God says, “Do not be afraid, for I am with you.” He will strengthen you, help you, and hold you up with his righteous hand.
promises.text: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend, you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’ Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

promises.promise: God promises that i, the Lord your God, hold your right hand; don’t be afraid—he will help you. Fear not, worm Jacob; he will help you, says your Redeemer.
promises.text: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’ Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

promises.promise: God promises that the poor and needy seeking water—I the Lord will answer; he will open rivers on bare heights and fountains in valleys.
promises.text: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them. I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

promises.promise: God’s chosen Servant brings justice to the nations. A bruised reed he will not break. He will not fail until he sets justice in the earth.
promises.text: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations. He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street. He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice. He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice on the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”

promises.promise: God promises that i, the Lord, have called you in righteousness and will hold your hand; he will give you as a lasting promise for the people, a light for the nations—to open blind eyes and free prisoners.
promises.text: “I, the LORD, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations, to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.

promises.promise: God says he will bring the blind by a way they don’t know; I will make darkness light before them and crooked places straight. I will do these things and not forsake them.
promises.text: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.

promises.promise: God promises that fear not, for he has redeemed you; he has called you by name—you are mine. When you pass through waters, he will be with you; through rivers, they won’t overflow; through fire, you won’t be burned.
promises.text: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine. When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

promises.promise: God promises that you are precious in my sight, and honored, and I love you; don’t be afraid, for he is with you—he will bring your children from the east.
promises.text: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you, therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.

promises.promise: God promises that you are my witnesses and his servant whom he has chosen—that you may know and believe me. I, even I, am the Lord; besides me there is no savior.
promises.text: “You are my witnesses,” says the LORD, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me. I myself am the LORD. Besides me, there is no savior.

promises.promise: God says not to cling only to the past. He is doing something new—even making a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert.
promises.text: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

promises.promise: God promises that i, even I, am he who blots out your wrongs for my own sake; he will not remember your sins.
promises.text: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.

promises.promise: God promises that fear not, Jacob his servant; he will pour water on the thirsty and streams on the dry ground; he will pour his Spirit on your children.
promises.text: This is what the LORD who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen. For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;

promises.promise: God promises that remember these things, Jacob—he has formed you; you will not be forgotten. he has blotted out your wrongs like a thick cloud; return to me, for he has redeemed you.
promises.text: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me. I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

promises.promise: God says he will go before you and make the rough places level; I will break doors of bronze and cut through bars of iron; I will give you treasures of darkness.
promises.text: “I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron. I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, the LORD, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.

promises.promise: God says he is the Lord, and there is no other; I will gird you though you have not known me—that they may know from east to west there is none besides me.
promises.text: I am the LORD, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me, that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no one else.

promises.promise: God promises that look to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for he is God, and there is no other.
promises.text: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

promises.promise: God promises that listen, house of Jacob—you carried from the womb: Even to old age he is he; even to gray hairs he will carry you. he has made, and he will bear; he will carry and will deliver.
promises.text: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb. Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

promises.promise: God promises that he has refined you, but not as silver; he has chosen you in the furnace of affliction—for my own sake, for how should his name be profaned?
promises.text: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction. For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.

promises.promise: God says he is the Lord your God, who teaches you to profit and leads you in the way you should go. Oh that you had listened—your peace would be like a river.
promises.text: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go. Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

promises.promise: God promises that it is too light a thing to raise up Jacob—he will also give you as a light to the nations, that my salvation may be to the end of the earth.
promises.text: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”

promises.promise: God answers in a time of favor and keeps his people. He guides them to springs of water. They will not hunger or thirst, and the heat will not strike them.
promises.text: The LORD says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time. I have helped you in a day of salvation. I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage, saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights. They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water.

promises.promise: Sing, heavens; rejoice, earth—for the Lord has comforted his people and will have compassion on his afflicted.
promises.text: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For the LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.

promises.promise: God promises that zion said, the Lord has forsaken me—but can a mother forget her nursing child? Even these may forget, yet he will not forget you. he has engraved you on the palms of my hands.
promises.text: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.” “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you! Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.

promises.promise: God promises that shall the prey be taken from the mighty? Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away; he will contend with those who contend with you, and he will save your children.
promises.text: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered? But the LORD says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children. I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine. Then all flesh shall know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”

promises.promise: The Lord GOD gives the tongue of disciples to sustain the weary with a word. Morning by morning he wakens the ear to hear.
promises.text: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught. The Lord GOD has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.

promises.promise: The Lord GOD helps me; therefore he is not confounded; he sets his face like flint. He who justifies me is near—who will contend?
promises.text: For the Lord GOD will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed. He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me. Behold, the Lord GOD will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.

promises.promise: the Lord has comforted Zion; he has made her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the Lord—joy and gladness found in her.
promises.text: For the LORD has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

promises.promise: Lift up your eyes to the heavens. The heavens will vanish like smoke, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.
promises.text: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.

promises.promise: The rescued of the Lord will return and come with singing to Zion; everlasting joy will be on their heads; they will obtain gladness and joy; sorrow and sighing will flee away.
promises.text: Those ransomed by the LORD will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

promises.promise: God himself promises to comfort you. You do not need to live in fear of people who are only passing away.
promises.text: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?
promises.context: God comforts people who fear other people.

promises.promise: My people will know my name; how beautiful on the mountains are the feet of anyone who brings good news, who publishes peace and salvation: Your God reigns!
promises.text: Therefore my people shall know my name. Therefore they shall know in that day that I am he who speaks. Behold, it is I.” How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

promises.promise: Break forth into joy—the Lord has comforted his people and redeemed Jerusalem; all ends of the earth see the salvation of our God.
promises.text: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem. The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
promises.context: Joy for those watching for God’s help.

promises.promise: He bore our griefs and carried our sorrows; he was wounded for our wrongs; the Lord has laid on him the sin of us all.
promises.text: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted. But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed. All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

promises.promise: Yet it pleased the Lord to bruise him; he will see his children and prolong his days; my righteous Servant will justify many—he will bear their sins.
promises.text: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and the LORD’s pleasure will prosper in his hand. After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.

promises.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed; forget the shame of your youth—your Maker is your husband; the Lord of Armies is his name; the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer.
promises.text: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more. For your Maker is your husband; the LORD of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.

promises.promise: God promises that for a small moment I forsook you, but with great mercies he will gather you; in overflowing wrath I hid his face, but with everlasting faithful love he will have mercy on you.
promises.text: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies. In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.

promises.promise: The mountains may depart, but my faithful love will not depart from you, nor will my lasting promise of peace be removed, says the Lord who has mercy on you.
promises.text: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says the LORD who has mercy on you.

promises.promise: God promises that o afflicted, storm-tossed, comfortless—he will lay your stones with colorful gems; all your children will be taught by the Lord, and great will be the peace of your children.
promises.text: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires. I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones. All your children will be taught by the LORD, and your children’s peace will be great.
promises.context: Rebuilt with jewels; taught by God.

promises.promise: In righteousness you will be established; you will be far from oppression and terror. No weapon formed against you will prevail; this is the heritage of God's servants.
promises.text: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you. Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you. “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy. No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of the LORD’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters. Buy wine and milk without money. Why spend for what doesn’t satisfy? Eat what is good.
promises.text: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price. Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.

promises.promise: God promises that incline your ear and come to me; hear, and your soul will live: he will make an everlasting lasting promise with you, even the sure mercies of David.
promises.text: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

promises.promise: Seek the Lord while he may be found; let the wicked forsake his way; return to the Lord and he will have mercy; to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
promises.text: Seek the LORD while he may be found. Call on him while he is near. Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to the LORD, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

promises.promise: My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways. As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways.
promises.text: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD. “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

promises.promise: As rain and snow water the earth, so God’s word that goes out from his mouth will not return empty. It will do what he sent it to do.
promises.text: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow and bud, and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater; so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.

promises.promise: You will go out with joy and be led forth with peace; mountains break forth into singing. Instead of thorn, cypress; an everlasting sign.
promises.text: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands. Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make a name for the LORD, for an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.”

promises.promise: God promises that let not the foreigner or eunuch say he is a dry tree—to the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths he will give in my house a name better than sons and daughters, an everlasting name.
promises.text: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD speak, saying, “The LORD will surely separate me from his people.” Do not let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.” For the LORD says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant, I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.

promises.promise: God promises that foreigners who join the Lord to serve him—he will bring to my holy mountain and make joyful in my house of prayer; my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.
promises.text: Also the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to serve him, and to love the LORD’s name, to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant, I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”

promises.promise: The High and Lofty One who inhabits eternity dwells with anyone who is of a contrite and humble spirit—to revive the spirit of the humble and the heart of the contrite.
promises.text: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.

promises.promise: God promises that he has seen his ways and will heal him; he will lead him also and restore comforts to him and to his mourners—creating the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace to him who is far off and to him who is near.
promises.text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners. I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says the LORD; “and I will heal them.”

promises.promise: The fast God chooses: loose bonds of wickedness, free the oppressed, share bread with the hungry. Then your light breaks forth like dawn and your healing springs quickly.
promises.text: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke? Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh? Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and the LORD’s glory will be your rear guard.

promises.promise: Then you will call and the Lord will answer; if you pour yourself out for the hungry, the Lord will guide continually, satisfy in drought, and make you like a watered garden.
promises.text: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly; and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday; and the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

promises.promise: God's hand is not shortened that it cannot save, nor his ear heavy that it cannot hear.
promises.text: Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.
promises.context: Problem is sin, not God’s power.

promises.promise: A Redeemer will come to Zion for those who turn from wrong; this is my lasting promise—my Spirit on you and my words in your mouth shall not depart from your children forever.
promises.text: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says the LORD. “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now on and forever.”

promises.promise: Arise, shine, for your light has come; the glory of the Lord rises upon you—nations come to your light and kings to the brightness of your rising.
promises.text: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the LORD’s glory has risen on you! For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but the LORD will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you. Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.

promises.promise: The sun will no longer be your light by day—the Lord will be your everlasting light; your God will be your glory; your days of mourning will end.
promises.text: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory. Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.

promises.promise: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on me to preach good news to the humble, bind up the brokenhearted, proclaim liberty to captives, comfort all who mourn. Give a garland for ashes, oil of joy for mourning.
promises.text: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound, to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn, to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.

promises.promise: Instead of shame, double portion; everlasting joy will be to them; I the Lord love justice and will make an everlasting lasting promise with them.
promises.text: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them. “For I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

promises.promise: God says he will greatly rejoice in the Lord—he has clothed me with garments of salvation and a robe of righteousness; as the earth brings forth buds, the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all nations.
promises.text: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels. For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.

promises.promise: Nations see your righteousness; you will be called by a new name; you will no longer be termed Forsaken or Desolate, but Hephzibah and Beulah—for the Lord delights in you.
promises.text: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which the LORD’s mouth will name. You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand. You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.

promises.promise: Say to Zion, your salvation comes; they will call them The Holy People, The Redeemed of the Lord; you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
promises.text: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’” They will call them “The Holy People, The LORD’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.

promises.promise: God says he will make mention of God's faithful love—in all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them; in his love he redeemed them and carried them all the days of old.
promises.text: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of the LORD and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses. For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior. In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

promises.promise: From of old men have not heard of a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him. You meet him who rejoices and works righteousness.
promises.text: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him. You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?

promises.promise: God promises to create new heavens and a new earth. Former troubles will not be remembered. He will rejoice in Jerusalem, and weeping will be heard no more.
promises.text: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind. But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy. I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.

promises.promise: God promises that before they call, he will answer; while they are yet speaking, he will hear.
promises.text: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

promises.promise: God says he will extend peace like a river; as one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you; you will be comforted in Jerusalem.
promises.text: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees. As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”

promises.promise: God promises that as the new heavens and the new earth which he will make remain before me, so your children and your name will remain.
promises.text: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me,” says the LORD, “so your offspring and your name shall remain.

promises.promise: God promises that before I formed you in the womb I knew you; before you were born he sets you apart; I appointed you a prophet to the nations.
promises.text: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

promises.promise: God promises that don’t say he is a child—you will go to whom he sends you. Don’t be afraid of their faces, for he is with you to deliver you.
promises.text: But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you. Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: God promises that they will fight against you, but they will not prevail; for he is with you to deliver you, says the Lord.
promises.text: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says the LORD, “to rescue you.”

promises.promise: God promises that return, backsliding Israel—he will not look in anger, for he is merciful. Return, backsliding children, for he is a husband to you; he will take you one from a city and two from a family.
promises.text: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says the LORD; ‘I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful,’ says the LORD. ‘I will not keep anger forever. Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against the LORD your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’” says the LORD. “Return, backsliding children,” says the LORD, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

promises.promise: God says he will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
promises.text: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

promises.promise: Stand in the ways and see. Ask for the old paths, where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls.
promises.text: The LORD says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

promises.promise: God promises that obey my voice, and he will be your God, and you will be his people; walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.
promises.text: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’

promises.promise: God promises that don’t glory in wisdom, might, or riches—glory in this: that you understand and know me, that he is the Lord who exercises faithful love, justice, and righteousness in the earth.
promises.text: The LORD says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the rich man glory in his riches. But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am the LORD who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness on the earth, for I delight in these things,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: God promises that obey my voice and do my commands—so you will be his people, and he will be your God.
promises.text: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;

promises.promise: God promises that if you return, he will restore you; he will make you a fortified bronze wall; they will fight but not prevail, for he is with you to save and deliver.
promises.text: Therefore the LORD says, “If you return, then I will bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take out the precious from the vile, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them. I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: God promises that days are coming when it will no longer be said, As the Lord lives who brought up Israel from Egypt, but who brought them from the north country—he will bring them back to their land.
promises.text: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that it will no more be said, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’ but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them.’ I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.

promises.promise: Blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord; he will be like a tree planted by water—leaf green in drought, not anxious in a year of drought, nor ceases from producing fruit.
promises.text: “Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, and whose confidence is in the LORD. For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.
promises.context: Trust vs cursed confidence in flesh.

promises.promise: The heart is deceitful above all things; I, the Lord, search the mind and try the heart, to give every man according to his ways.
promises.text: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it? “I, the LORD, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.”

promises.promise: God says he will gather the remnant of my flock and bring them back to their folds; they will be fruitful. I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them; they will fear no more nor be dismayed.
promises.text: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply. I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be lacking,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: God promises that days are coming—he will raise to David a righteous Branch; he will reign as king and execute justice; Judah saved, Israel dwell safely; name: the Lord our righteousness.
promises.text: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch; and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land. In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: The LORD our righteousness.

promises.promise: God says he will set my eyes on them for good and bring them again to this land; I will build and not pull down. I will give them a heart to know me—they will be my people, and I will be their God.
promises.text: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. I will build them, and not pull them down. I will plant them, and not pluck them up. I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the LORD. They will be my people, and I will be their God; for they will return to me with their whole heart.

promises.promise: God promises to keep his good word and bring his people home. He has plans for their welfare—plans for hope and a future, not for harm.
promises.text: For the LORD says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place. For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
promises.context: A letter of hope to God’s people far from home.

promises.promise: God promises that when you call and pray, he will listen. When you seek him with all your heart, you will find him—and he will bring you back from captivity.
promises.text: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you. You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart. I will be found by you,” says the LORD, “and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you,” says the LORD. “I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.”

promises.promise: God says he will break his yoke; don’t be afraid, Jacob, neither be dismayed—I will save you from afar; Jacob will return and be quiet and at ease, and no one will make him afraid.
promises.text: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds. Strangers will no more make them their bondservants; but they will serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them. Therefore don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says the LORD. Don’t be dismayed, Israel. For, behold, I will save you from afar, and save your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

promises.promise: God says he will restore health to you and heal you of your wounds, because they called you an outcast: It is Zion, whom no one cares for.
promises.text: For I will restore health to you, and I will heal you of your wounds,” says the LORD, “because they have called you an outcast, saying, ‘It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.’”

promises.promise: God says he will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
promises.text: The LORD says: “Behold, I will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places. The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place. Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small. Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who oppress them. Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he will approach me; for who is he who has had boldness to approach me?” says the LORD. “You shall be my people, and I will be your God.

promises.promise: God promises that he has loved you with an everlasting love; therefore with faithful love he has drawn you.
promises.text: The LORD appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.

promises.promise: God says he will bring them from the north country—the blind and lame, the woman with child; they will come with weeping, and with petitions I will lead them; I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters in a straight way.
promises.text: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together. They will return as a great company. They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they won’t stumble; for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn.

promises.promise: God promises that they will come and sing in Zion height and flow to the goodness of the Lord; their soul will be as a watered garden; he will satiate the priests with fatness and his people will be satisfied with my goodness.
promises.text: They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of the LORD, to the grain, to the new wine, to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd. Their soul will be as a watered garden. They will not sorrow any more at all. Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow. I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: Refrain your voice from weeping—your work will be rewarded. They will come back from the land of the enemy. There is hope for your latter end. Your children will come back to their own border.
promises.text: The LORD says: “Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded,” says the LORD. “They will come again from the land of the enemy. There is hope for your latter end,” says the LORD. “Your children will come again to their own territory.

promises.promise: God promises that is Ephraim my dear son? Since I spoke against him, I earnestly remember him still; my heart yearns; he will surely have mercy on him.
