promises.text: Is Ephraim my dear son? Is he a darling child? For as often as I speak against him, I still earnestly remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him. I will surely have mercy on him,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: God promises that for he has satiated the weary soul, and he has replenished every sorrowful soul.
promises.text: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.”

promises.promise: God promises a new lasting promise: he will write his ways on people’s hearts, be their God, and forgive their sin—remembering it no more.
promises.text: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah, not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, which covenant of mine they broke, although I was a husband to them,” says the LORD. “But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the LORD: “I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart. I will be their God, and they shall be my people. They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD;’ for they will all know me, from their least to their greatest,” says the LORD, “for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.”
promises.context: God promises a new, heart-deep relationship.

promises.promise: Ah, Lord GOD! you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power—there is nothing too hard for you.
promises.text: “Ah Lord GOD! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.
promises.context: Prayer in prison before buying field.

promises.promise: God promises that he is the Lord, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?
promises.text: “Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?

promises.promise: God promises to gather his people, let them live in safety, give them one heart to fear him, and make an everlasting promise to do them good.
promises.text: “Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place. I will cause them to dwell safely. Then they will be my people, and I will be their God. I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good and the good of their children after them. I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me. Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”

promises.promise: God promises that call to me, and he will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.
promises.text: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

promises.promise: God says he will bring health and cure; I will reveal abundance of peace and truth; I will reverse captivity; it will be to me a name of joy, praise, and glory before all nations.
promises.text: behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth. I will restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel, and will build them as at the first. I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against me. I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned against me and by which they have transgressed against me. This city will be to me for a name of joy, for praise, and for glory, before all the nations of the earth, which will hear all the good that I do to them, and will fear and tremble for all the good and for all the peace that I provide to it.’”

promises.promise: Yet again will be heard in this place the voice of joy and gladness, bridegroom and bride, and of those who say, Give thanks to the Lord of Armies, for the Lord is good; his faithful love endures forever.
promises.text: The LORD says: “Yet again there will be heard in this place, about which you say, ‘It is waste, without man and without animal, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,’ the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, ‘Give thanks to the LORD of Armies, for the LORD is good, for his loving kindness endures forever;’ who bring thanksgiving into the LORD’s house. For I will cause the captivity of the land to be reversed as at the first,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: God promises that days are coming—he will perform the good word; he will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David; Judah will be saved; Jerusalem dwell safely; name: the Lord our righteousness.
promises.text: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah. “In those days and at that time, I will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. He will execute justice and righteousness in the land. In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell safely. This is the name by which she will be called: The LORD our righteousness.”

promises.promise: God promises that if you can break his lasting promise of the day and night, then his lasting promise with David and the Levitical priests may also be broken—he will multiply David’s seed as the host of heaven.
promises.text: “The LORD says: ‘If you can break my covenant of the day and my covenant of the night, so that there will not be day and night in their time, then my covenant could also be broken with David my servant, that he won’t have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levitical priests, my ministers. As the army of the sky can’t be counted, and the sand of the sea can’t be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of David my servant and the Levites who minister to me.’”

promises.promise: God promises to rescue you in the day of trouble. You will not be handed over to those you fear. Because you trust him, your life will be spared as a prize.
promises.text: But I will deliver you in that day,” says the LORD; “and you will not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid. For I will surely save you. You won’t fall by the sword, but you will escape with your life, because you have put your trust in me,” says the LORD.’”

promises.promise: God promises that if you stay in this land, he will build and not pull down; he will plant and not pluck up; don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon—he is with you to save you and deliver you; he will grant mercies.
promises.text: ‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you. Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Don’t be afraid of him,’ says the LORD, ‘for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand. I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

promises.promise: God promises that don’t be afraid, Jacob his servant; he will save you from afar; Jacob return and be quiet. Don’t fear—he is with you; he will make a full end of the nations, but not of you; he will correct you in measure.
promises.text: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid. Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says the LORD, “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”

promises.promise: In those days Israel and Judah will come weeping and seek the Lord; they will ask the way to Zion, saying, Come and join yourselves to the Lord in an everlasting lasting promise that will not be forgotten.
promises.text: “In those days, and in that time,” says the LORD, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek the LORD their God. They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, and join yourselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.’

promises.promise: God says he will bring Israel again to his pasture; in those days sin will be sought and not found, for I will pardon those whom I leave as a remnant.
promises.text: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he will feed on Carmel and Bashan. His soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead. In those days, and in that time,” says the LORD, “the iniquity of Israel will be sought for, and there will be none, also the sins of Judah, and they won’t be found; for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

promises.promise: This I recall to mind: God's loving kindnesses never cease; his compassions never fail; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
promises.text: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope. It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
promises.context: Hope in the middle of lament.

promises.promise: God promises that the Lord is my portion; therefore he will hope in him. the Lord is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him. It is good to hope and wait quietly for God's salvation.
promises.text: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.” The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him. It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

promises.promise: The Lord will not cast off forever. Though he causes grief, he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses—he does not afflict from his heart.
promises.text: For the Lord will not cast off forever. For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses. For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

promises.promise: God promises that i called on your name from the lowest dungeon; you heard my voice. You drew near when I called; you said, Don’t be afraid. Lord, you pleaded my soul’s cause; you redeemed my life.
promises.text: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon. You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.” You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.” Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

promises.promise: God says he will give them one heart and put a new spirit within; I will take the stony heart and give a heart of flesh, that they may walk in my ways and be my people, and I will be their God.
promises.text: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh, that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

promises.promise: God promises that nevertheless he will remember his lasting promise with you in the days of your youth and establish an everlasting lasting promise; he will establish his lasting promise that you may know he is the Lord; he will forgive all you have done.
promises.text: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you. Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant. I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am the LORD; that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord GOD.’”
promises.context: Jerusalem’s unfaithfulness met by everlasting lasting promise.

promises.promise: If the wicked turns from sins and keeps ways, he will live—have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked? says the Lord GOD, and not rather that he should return and live?
promises.text: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die. None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live. Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord GOD, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

promises.promise: God promises that return and turn from wrongs; cast away wrongs; make a new heart and spirit. For he has no pleasure in the death of him who dies; therefore turn and live.
promises.text: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord GOD. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin. Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel? For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord GOD. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!

promises.promise: God says he will accept you as a sweet aroma when I bring you from the peoples; I will be sanctified in you; you will know I am the Lord when I deal with you for my name’s sake, not according to evil ways.
promises.text: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered. I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations. You will know that I am the LORD when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers. There you will remember your ways, and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves. Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed. You will know that I am the LORD, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord GOD.’”

promises.promise: When I gather Israel from peoples and am made holy in them, they will dwell in their land safely, build houses, plant vineyards, and dwell securely when I execute judgments on neighbors.
promises.text: “‘The Lord GOD says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob. They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.”’”

promises.promise: God promises that i myself will search for my sheep and seek them out—as a shepherd seeks flock on cloudy day, so he will seek out my sheep and deliver them from all places scattered.
promises.text: “‘For the Lord GOD says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out. As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

promises.promise: God says he will bring them out from peoples and gather to their land; I will feed them on mountains of Israel; I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep and make them lie down.
promises.text: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country. I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel. I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord GOD.

promises.promise: God says he will seek that which was lost, bring back that which was driven away, bind up that which was broken, and strengthen that which was sick.
promises.text: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’

promises.promise: God says he will save my flock; they will no more be a prey; I will set up one shepherd over them, my servant David; I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David prince among them.
promises.text: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep. I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd. I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, the LORD, have spoken it.

promises.promise: God says he will make a lasting promise of peace; eliminate evil animals; they will dwell securely; I will make them and places around my hill a blessing; showers of blessing.
promises.text: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods. I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.

promises.promise: God promises that the tree yields fruit, earth yield increase; they know he is the Lord when I break bars of yoke and deliver from hand of those who enslaved them; they will no more be a prey; none will make them afraid.
promises.text: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them. They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.

promises.promise: God promises that they will know that I, the Lord their God, am with them, and that they are his people; you my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are people, and he is your God.
promises.text: They will know that I, the LORD, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord GOD. You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord GOD.”

promises.promise: God is for you. He promises to turn toward you again, make the land fruitful, multiply people, and do good to you as in earlier days.
promises.text: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown. I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built. I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

promises.promise: God says he will take you from the nations, gather from all lands, bring to your own land; I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; from idols I will cleanse you.
promises.text: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land. I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

promises.promise: God promises a new heart and a new spirit. He will remove the hard heart of stone, give a heart of flesh, put his Spirit in you, and be your God.
promises.text: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh. I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them. You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

promises.promise: God says he will save you from uncleanness; I will call for grain and multiply it and lay no famine; I will multiply fruit of tree and yield of field.
promises.text: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you. I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

promises.promise: God promises that in day I cleanse from sins he will cause cities to be inhabited; desolate land tilled; nations know I the Lord built ruined places—I the Lord have spoken and will do it.
promises.text: “‘The Lord GOD says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built. The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by. They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’ Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, the LORD, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken it, and I will do it.”

promises.promise: God says he will cause breath to enter you and you will live; I will lay sinews, bring flesh, cover with skin, put breath in you; you will live, and know I am the Lord.
promises.text: The Lord GOD says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live. I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”’”

promises.promise: God promises to open the graves of his people, bring them home, and put his Spirit in them so they will live—and know that he is the Lord.
promises.text: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel. You will know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people. I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it and performed it,” says the LORD.’”

promises.promise: God says he will take Israelites from nations, gather, bring to land; make one nation; one king; no more defile; I will save and cleanse; they will be my people, I their God.
promises.text: Say to them, ‘The Lord GOD says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land. I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all. They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.

promises.promise: God promises that david his servant king forever; lasting promise of peace everlasting; he will set sanctuary in midst forever; my dwelling with them; I their God, they his people—nations know when sanctuary is forever.
promises.text: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them. They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever. Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more. My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

promises.promise: God says he will reverse captivity of Jacob and have mercy on whole house of Israel; I will not hide my face any more; I will pour out my Spirit on Israel, says the Lord GOD.
promises.text: “Therefore the Lord GOD says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name. They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations. They will know that I am the LORD their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more. I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord GOD.”

promises.promise: Waters from the temple go toward east. When they enter the sea, waters are healed. Every living creature swarms wherever the river comes will live.
promises.text: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed. It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.

promises.promise: By the river trees for food. Leaf won’t wither nor fruit fail. Fruit for food, leaf for healing.
promises.text: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

promises.promise: Blessed be God’s name forever. He changes times and seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings.
promises.text: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his. He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding. He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

promises.promise: In days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed. It will break other kingdoms and stand forever.
promises.text: “In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.

promises.promise: Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace. But if not, we won’t serve your gods.
promises.text: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”

promises.promise: God promises that look, he sees four men loose, walking in the fire, and they have no hurt; the aspect of the fourth is like a son of the gods.
promises.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished and rose up in haste. He spoke and said to his counselors, “Didn’t we cast three men bound into the middle of the fire?” They answered the king, “True, O king.” He answered, “Look, I see four men loose, walking in the middle of the fire, and they are unharmed. The appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.”

promises.promise: God promises that i blessed the Most High; his dominion is everlasting; all inhabitants of earth are reputed as nothing; he does according to his will; none can stop his hand or ask, What are you doing?
promises.text: At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me; and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored him who lives forever, for his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom from generation to generation. All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth; and no one can stop his hand, or ask him, “What are you doing?”

promises.promise: My God has sent his angel and has shut the lions’ mouths. They have not hurt me.
promises.text: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me, because innocence was found in me before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm.”

promises.promise: He is the living God, steadfast forever. His kingdom won’t be destroyed. He delivers and rescues, works signs in heaven and earth.
promises.text: “I make a decree that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel. “For he is the living God, and steadfast forever. His kingdom is that which will not be destroyed. His dominion will be even to the end. He delivers and rescues. He works signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.”

promises.promise: One like a son of man came with clouds; dominion, glory, kingdom given. All peoples serve him; dominion everlasting, won’t pass away; kingdom won’t be destroyed.
promises.text: “I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before him. Dominion was given him, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and languages should serve him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion, which will not pass away, and his kingdom one that will not be destroyed.

promises.promise: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom. Possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.
promises.text: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.’

promises.promise: The kingdom and dominion under whole heaven will be given to people of saints of Most High. Kingdom everlasting. All dominions serve and obey.
promises.text: The kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole sky, will be given to the people of the saints of the Most High. His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions will serve and obey him.’

promises.promise: Mercy and forgiveness belong to the Lord our God—even though we have rebelled against him.
promises.text: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him.

promises.promise: We don’t present pleas for our righteousness but for your great mercies. Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer for your own sake.
promises.text: My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake. Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

promises.promise: God promises that don’t be afraid, Daniel; from the first day you set your heart to understand and humble yourself, your words were heard, and he has come for your words’ sake.
promises.text: Then he said to me, “Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard. I have come for your words’ sake.

promises.promise: One like appearance of a person touched me and strengthened me: Peace be to you. Be strong, be strong. When he spoke, I was strengthened.
promises.text: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me. He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.”

promises.promise: At that time Michael will stand up. There will be a time of trouble such as never was. But your people will be delivered, everyone found written in the book.
promises.text: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.

promises.promise: Many who sleep in the dust will awake, some to everlasting life. Those who are wise will shine as brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness as the stars forever.
promises.text: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt. Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.

promises.promise: Go your way until the end. For you will rest, then rise again to receive your inheritance at the end of the days.
promises.text: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”

promises.promise: Yet the number of Israel will be as sand of sea. In place where said Not my people, it will be said Sons of the living God.
promises.text: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

promises.promise: God says he will allure her and bring her into wilderness and speak comfortably; I will give vineyards from there and Valley of Achor for door of hope; she will respond as in youth.
promises.text: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her. I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

promises.promise: God promises that you will call me My husband; he will betroth you to me forever in righteousness, justice, faithful love, mercies, and faithfulness; you will know the Lord.
promises.text: It will be in that day,” says the LORD, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’ For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name. In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely. I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion. I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know the LORD.

promises.promise: God says he will sow her to me in earth; I will have mercy on No Mercy; I will say to Not my people, You are my people; they will say, My God.
promises.text: It will happen in that day, that I will respond,” says the LORD. “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth; and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel. I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘You are My God!’”

promises.promise: Come, let’s return to the Lord. He has torn, but he will heal. He will bind us up, restore us, and come to us like the spring rains.
promises.text: “Come! Let’s return to the LORD; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds. After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him. Let’s acknowledge the LORD. Let’s press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, the LORD will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”

promises.promise: When Israel was a child, then I loved him. Called my son out of Egypt.
promises.text: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

promises.promise: God promises that i taught Ephraim to walk; I took them on my arms; I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love; I lifted yoke and laid food before them.
promises.text: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them. I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.

promises.promise: God promises that how can he gives you up, Ephraim? My heart is turned within me; my compassions are kindled. he will not execute fierceness of anger—for he is God and not man, the Holy One among you.
promises.text: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused. I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.

promises.promise: God says he will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away. I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily.
promises.text: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them. I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.

promises.promise: Men will rest in his shade. They will revive as grain and blossom as vine.
promises.text: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.

promises.promise: Turn to me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, mourning; tear your heart and not garments; turn to the Lord—for he is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, abundant in faithful love, and relents from sending calamity.
promises.text: “Yet even now,” says the LORD, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.” Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to the LORD, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.

promises.promise: God promises that then the Lord was jealous for his land and had pity on his people; he will send you grain, new wine, oil, and you will be satisfied; he will no more make you a reproach among nations.
promises.text: Then the LORD was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people. The LORD answered his people, “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied with them; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.

promises.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid, land; rejoice—the Lord has done great things. Don’t be afraid, animals—pastures spring, tree bears fruit.
promises.text: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for the LORD has done great things. Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.

promises.promise: Rejoice in the Lord your God—he gives former rain moderately and rains; threshing floors full of wheat, vats overflow.
promises.text: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before. The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

promises.promise: God says he will restore to you the years the swarming locust has eaten; you will eat plenty and be satisfied; my people will never be disappointed; you will know I am in midst of Israel.
promises.text: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you. You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of the LORD, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed. You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am the LORD, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.

promises.promise: God says he will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; sons and daughters prophesy; old dream; young see visions; on servants and handmaids I will pour out my Spirit.
promises.text: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions. And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.

promises.promise: It will happen that whoever will call on God's name will be saved; for in Mount Zion and Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as the Lord has said, and among the remnant those whom the Lord calls.
promises.text: It will happen that whoever will call on the LORD’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as the LORD has said, and among the remnant, those whom the LORD calls.
promises.context: Anyone who calls on the Lord can be saved.

promises.promise: God promises that the Lord will roar from Zion; the Lord will be a refuge to his people, a stronghold to Israel. So you will know he is the Lord your God, dwelling in Zion my holy mountain.
promises.text: The LORD will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but the LORD will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel. “So you will know that I am the LORD, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.

promises.promise: In that day mountains will drop sweet wine, hills flow with milk, all brooks of Judah flow with waters; a fountain will come from God's house.
promises.text: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters; and a fountain will flow out from the LORD’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.

promises.promise: God says, “Seek me, and you will live.”
promises.text: For the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;

promises.promise: Seek good and not evil, that you may live; hate evil, love good, establish justice—it may be that the Lord of Armies will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.
promises.text: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say. Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that the LORD, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”

promises.promise: God promises that in that day he will raise up David’s fallen tent and close up breaches; that they may possess remnant of Edom and nations called by his name.
promises.text: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old, that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name,” says the LORD who does this.

promises.promise: God promises that days come—plowman overtakes reaper; mountains drop sweet wine; he will reverse captivity; they will rebuild cities and plant; he will plant them on their land and they will no more be pulled up.
promises.text: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the one treading grapes him who sows seed; and sweet wine will drip from the mountains, and flow from the hills. I will bring my people Israel back from captivity, and they will rebuild the ruined cities, and inhabit them; and they will plant vineyards, and drink wine from them. They shall also make gardens, and eat their fruit. I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says the LORD your God.

promises.promise: The day of the Lord is near on all nations; as you have done it will be done to you. But in Mount Zion there will be those who escape, and it will be holy; Jacob possess possessions.
promises.text: For the day of the LORD is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head. For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been. But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.

promises.promise: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge Esau’s mountain; the kingdom will be God's.
promises.text: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be the LORD’s.

promises.promise: Jonah prayed from the fish’s belly: I called because of my affliction to the Lord; he answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried; you heard my voice.
promises.text: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD, his God, out of the fish’s belly. He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.

promises.promise: God promises that i went down to the bottoms of mountains; the earth barred me forever—yet you have brought my life up from the pit. When my soul fainted, I remembered the Lord; my prayer came to you.
promises.text: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God. “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.

promises.promise: God promises that those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy. But he will sacrifice with voice of thanksgiving; salvation belongs to the Lord.
promises.text: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy. But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.”

promises.promise: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent and turn from fierce anger that we not perish? God saw their works, that they turned. God relented of the disaster.
promises.text: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?” God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.

promises.promise: You are a gracious God, merciful, slow to anger, abundant in faithful love, and you relent of doing harm.
promises.text: He prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please, LORD, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.

promises.promise: In latter days mountain of Lord’s house established; nations stream; he teaches ways; they beat swords into plowshares; nation not lift sword; nor learn war anymore.
promises.text: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of the LORD’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it. Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem; and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.

promises.promise: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree; no one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the Lord of Armies has spoken.
promises.text: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of the LORD of Armies has spoken.

promises.promise: Though all peoples walk each in name of his god, we will walk in the name of the Lord our God forever and ever.
promises.text: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.

promises.promise: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah—though small among Judah’s clans—out of you will come a ruler for God, whose origins are from ancient days.
promises.text: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.

promises.promise: He will stand and shepherd in God's strength; they will live securely; he will be great to ends of earth. This one will be our peace.
promises.text: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. They will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth. He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

promises.promise: God has shown you what is good: to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.
promises.text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does the LORD require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

promises.promise: God promises that but as for me, he will look to the Lord. he will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
promises.text: But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me. Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, the LORD will be a light to me.
promises.context: Fall and arise; light in darkness.

promises.promise: God says he will bear the indignation of the Lord because I have sinned; until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me into the light, and I will see his righteousness.
promises.text: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.

promises.promise: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and passes over wrong of remnant? He doesn’t retain anger forever, because he delights in faithful love. He will again have compassion; he will tread our sins; cast all sins into depths of sea.
promises.text: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness. He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

promises.promise: You will give truth to Jacob and faithful love to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from days of old.
promises.text: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

promises.promise: the Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
promises.text: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

promises.promise: For the vision is yet for the appointed time. It hurries toward the end and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
promises.text: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

promises.promise: his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
promises.text: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

promises.promise: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of God's glory, as the waters cover the sea.
promises.text: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.

promises.promise: God promises that though fig tree doesn’t flourish nor vines fruit, olive fail, fields food, flock cut off—yet he will rejoice in the Lord; he will be joyful in the God of my salvation. the Lord is my strength; he makes my feet like deer’s and enables me on high places.
promises.text: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation! GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

promises.promise: God promises that then he will purify peoples’ lips that all may call on Lord’s name and serve shoulder to shoulder; from beyond rivers of Ethiopia my worshipers will bring offering.
promises.text: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on the LORD’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder. From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

promises.promise: God promises that you will not be put to shame for deeds; he will remove proud; he will leave among you a meek and humble people, and they will take refuge in God's name.
promises.text: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain. But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in the LORD’s name.

promises.promise: The remnant of Israel won’t do sin nor speak lies; for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.
promises.text: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

promises.promise: Sing, daughter Zion; the Lord has taken away judgments, cast out enemy; the King of Israel, the Lord, is in your midst; you will not be afraid of evil any more.
promises.text: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem. The LORD has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

promises.promise: Do not be afraid. The Lord your God is in your midst—a mighty one who saves. He will rejoice over you with joy and quiet you with his love.
promises.text: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.” The LORD, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
promises.context: God rejoices over you with singing.

promises.promise: God promises to deal with oppressors, save the lame, gather the outcast, and change shame into praise. He will bring you home and restore your fortunes.
promises.text: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth. At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says the LORD.

promises.promise: God promises that then Haggai, God's messenger, spoke God's message: he is with you, says the Lord.
promises.text: Then Haggai, the LORD’s messenger, spoke the LORD’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: God promises that be strong, Zerubbabel; be strong, Joshua; be strong, all people of land—work, for he is with you. According to the word I covenanted when you came out of Egypt, so his Spirit remains among you. Don’t be afraid.
promises.text: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says the LORD. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says the LORD, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says the LORD of Armies. This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

promises.promise: God says he will shake heavens and earth; I will fill this house with glory; the latter glory of this house will be greater than former; in this place I will give peace.
promises.text: For this is what the LORD of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land; and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies. The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says the LORD of Armies. ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”

promises.promise: God promises that is the seed yet in the barn? From this day he will bless you.
promises.text: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”

promises.promise: God says he will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, and will make you as a signet, for I have chosen you.
promises.text: In that day, says the LORD of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says the LORD, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says the LORD of Armies.”

promises.promise: God promises that return to me, says the Lord of Armies, and he will return to you.
promises.text: Therefore tell them, the LORD of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the LORD of Armies.

promises.promise: God promises that he has returned to Jerusalem with mercies; my house will be built; cities will again overflow with prosperity; the Lord will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.
promises.text: Therefore the LORD says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says the LORD of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’ “Proclaim further, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”

promises.promise: God promises that jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls; he will be to her a wall of fire around, and he will be the glory in her midst.
promises.text: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it. For I,’ says the LORD, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

promises.promise: God promises that he who touches you touches the apple of his eye; he will shake hand over them; you will know the Lord of Armies has sent me.
promises.text: For the LORD of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye. For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me.

promises.promise: God promises that sing and rejoice, daughter Zion—for I come and he will dwell among you; many nations will join themselves to the Lord and be his people; he will dwell among you.
promises.text: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says the LORD. Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

promises.promise: God promises that take the filthy garments off him; he has caused your sin to pass from you, and he will clothe you with rich clothing; set a clean turban on his head.
promises.text: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.” I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and the LORD’s angel was standing by.

promises.promise: God says he will bring my servant, the Branch; I will remove the sin of that land in one day.
promises.text: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch. For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

promises.promise: Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the Lord of Armies.
promises.text: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.

promises.promise: God promises that he has returned to Zion and will dwell in Jerusalem; Jerusalem will be called City of Truth; old men and women sit in streets with staff.
promises.text: The LORD says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of the LORD of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’” The LORD of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.

promises.promise: God says he will save my people from east and west; I will bring them; they will dwell in Jerusalem; they will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
promises.text: The LORD of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country. I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

promises.promise: God promises that seed of peace; vine yield fruit; ground increase; heavens dew; remnant possess; as you were a curse among nations, so he will save you and you will be a blessing; don’t be afraid.
promises.text: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things. It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”

promises.promise: Speak truth; execute judgment of peace; don’t devise evil; love no false oath. For these I hate.
promises.text: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates, and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says the LORD.

promises.promise: Rejoice greatly, daughter Zion—your king comes to you, righteous and having salvation, lowly riding on donkey. He will speak peace to nations. Dominion from sea to sea.
promises.text: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey. I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
promises.context: King comes; peace to nations (Triumphal Entry).

promises.promise: God promises that because of blood of lasting promise he has set free your prisoners from the pit; return to stronghold, prisoners of hope; even today I declare he will restore double to you.
promises.text: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water. Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

promises.promise: Ask of the Lord rain in spring; the Lord who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
promises.text: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.

promises.promise: God says he will strengthen house of Judah and save house of Joseph; I will bring them back for I have mercy; they will be as though I hadn’t cast them off; for I am the Lord their God and I will hear them.
promises.text: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.

promises.promise: Thus says the Lord who stretches out heavens, lays foundation of earth, and forms spirit of man within him.
promises.text: A revelation of the LORD’s word concerning Israel: The LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:

promises.promise: God says he will pour on David’s house and Jerusalem’s inhabitants the spirit of grace and of supplication; they will look to me whom they have pierced; they will mourn.
promises.text: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.

promises.promise: In that day a fountain will be opened for David’s house and Jerusalem’s people—for sin and for uncleanness.
promises.text: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

promises.promise: God says he will bring the third part through fire, refine as silver, try as gold; they will call on my name and I will hear; I will say, It is my people; they will say, the Lord is my God.
promises.text: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will hear them. I will say, ‘It is my people;’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is my God.’”

promises.promise: Living waters will go out from Jerusalem; the Lord will be King over all the earth; in that day the Lord will be one, and his name one.
promises.text: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter. The LORD will be King over all the earth. In that day the LORD will be one, and his name one.

promises.promise: God promises that he has loved you, says the Lord. Yet you say, How have you loved us? Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?
promises.text: “I have loved you,” says the LORD. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says the LORD, “Yet I loved Jacob;

promises.promise: God promises that he sends my messenger and he will prepare the way before me; the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to his temple.
promises.text: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says the LORD of Armies.

promises.promise: For I, the Lord, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
promises.text: “For I, the LORD, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

promises.promise: God promises that return to me, and he will return to you, says the Lord of Armies.
promises.text: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

promises.promise: God promises that bring whole tithe into storehouse; prove me now—if he will not open windows of heaven and pour out a blessing that there won’t be room enough; he will rebuke devourer.
promises.text: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says the LORD of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for. I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says the LORD of Armies.

promises.promise: God promises that those who feared the Lord spoke; a book of remembrance was written; they will be mine, says the Lord of Armies, in the day when he makes up my jewels; he will spare them as a man spares his son.
promises.text: Then those who feared the LORD spoke one with another; and the LORD listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared the LORD and who honored his name. They shall be mine,” says the LORD of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.

promises.promise: But to you who fear my name, the sun of righteousness will arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.
promises.text: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.

promises.promise: You will call his name Jesus, for he will save you from their sins. They will call him Immanuel, which means God with us.
promises.text: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.” Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

promises.promise: People do not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from God’s mouth.
promises.text: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

promises.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are the poor in spirit, mourners, meek, hungering for righteousness, merciful, pure, peacemakers, and persecuted—for theirs is the kingdom, comfort, inheritance, fullness, mercy, seeing God, and being called sons.
promises.text: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven. Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted. Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth. Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled. Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy. Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God. Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God. Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

promises.promise: God promises blessing here: blessed when people revile and persecute you—rejoice and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven.
promises.text: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake. Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

promises.promise: Pray to your Father in secret. Your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
promises.text: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

promises.promise: Your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
promises.text: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

promises.promise: Pray: Our Father in heaven—hallowed name, kingdom come, will done, daily bread, forgive as we forgive, deliver from evil. For yours is kingdom, power, glory forever.
promises.text: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us today our daily bread. Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

promises.promise: If you forgive others, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
promises.text: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

promises.promise: Jesus says not to worry about your life—what you will eat or wear. Look at the birds: they do not sow, yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
promises.text: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing? See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

promises.promise: Which of you by worrying can add a single hour to your life? If God clothes the grass so beautifully, will he not much more clothe you?
promises.text: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan? Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin, yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these. But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

promises.promise: Jesus says not to worry about what you will eat or drink. Your Father knows you need these things. Seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.
promises.text: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’ For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things. But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well. Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
promises.context: Jesus teaches not to worry about tomorrow.

promises.promise: Ask, and it will be given to you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened. Everyone who asks receives.
promises.text: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

promises.promise: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to people who ask him?
promises.text: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent? If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

promises.promise: God promises that everyone who hears these words and does them is like a wise man who built on rock; rain, floods, winds came—house didn’t fall.
promises.text: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock. The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

promises.promise: Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean. Jesus touched him: I want to. Be made clean. Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
promises.text: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.” Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

promises.promise: He cast out spirits and healed all who were sick. That it might be fulfilled: He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.
