promises.text: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

promises.promise: Take heart, child—your sins are forgiven.
promises.text: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

promises.promise: Those who are healthy don’t need a physician, but people who are sick. I desire mercy and not sacrifice, for I came to call sinners, not the righteous.
promises.text: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do. But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

promises.promise: God promises that if I only touch his garment, he will be made well. Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.
promises.text: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.” But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

promises.promise: Jesus had compassion on the crowds—they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd. Pray that the Lord of harvest send laborers.
promises.text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd. Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

promises.promise: Jesus says don’t be anxious how or what you will speak; it will be given in that hour—for it isn’t you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
promises.text: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say. For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

promises.promise: Do not fear people who can only harm the body. You are precious to your Father—more than many sparrows. Even the hairs of your head are all counted.
promises.text: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna. “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will. But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

promises.promise: God promises that everyone who confesses me before men, he will also confess before my Father in heaven.
promises.text: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

promises.promise: God promises that anyone who finds his life will lose it, and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.
promises.text: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

promises.promise: God promises that whoever gives one of these little ones a cup of cold water because he is a disciple will by no means lose his reward.
promises.text: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

promises.promise: Jesus invites you to come to him when you are tired and weighed down. He promises rest for your soul. His way is gentle, and his burden is light.
promises.text: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
promises.context: Jesus invites the weary to find rest.

promises.promise: God promises that his servant whom he has chosen; he will put his Spirit on him; he won’t break bruised reed; nations will hope in his name.
promises.text: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations. He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets. He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory. In his name, the nations will hope.”

promises.promise: Every sin and speaking against God will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
promises.text: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

promises.promise: Then those who walk with God will shine like the sun in their Father’s kingdom. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
promises.text: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

promises.promise: But immediately Jesus spoke: Cheer up! It is I! Do not be afraid.
promises.text: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

promises.promise: God promises that on this rock he will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it. he will give you keys of Kingdom of Heaven.
promises.text: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it. I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

promises.promise: If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross. Follow me. Whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.
promises.text: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me. For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

promises.promise: God promises that this is my beloved Son, in whom he is well pleased. Listen to him.
promises.text: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

promises.promise: Unless you turn and become as little children, you will not enter Kingdom of Heaven. Whoever humbles himself as this little child is greatest.
promises.text: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven. Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

promises.promise: See that you do not despise one of these little ones, for their angels always see my Father’s face.
promises.text: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

promises.promise: If a man has 100 sheep and one goes astray, he seeks the one. It is not Father’s will that one of these little ones perish.
promises.text: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray? If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray. Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

promises.promise: God promises that if two agree on earth concerning anything they ask, it will be done by my Father. For where two or three are gathered in his name, there he is in their midst.
promises.text: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven. For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

promises.promise: Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me. For the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.
promises.text: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

promises.promise: With people this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.
promises.text: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

promises.promise: In regeneration when the Son of Man sits on throne, you who followed will also sit on twelve thrones. Everyone who left houses or family for my name will receive one hundred times and inherit eternal life.
promises.text: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel. Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

promises.promise: God promises that whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant; Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
promises.text: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant. Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant, even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

promises.promise: If you have faith and don’t doubt, even to this mountain, Be taken up. It will be done. All things whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.
promises.text: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done. All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

promises.promise: Anyone who endures to the end will be saved.
promises.text: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

promises.promise: They will see Son of Man coming on clouds with power and great glory. He will send angels with trumpet to gather elect from four winds.
promises.text: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory. He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

promises.promise: Heaven and earth will pass away, but Jesus’ words will never pass away.
promises.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

promises.promise: God promises that well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things; he will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.
promises.text: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

promises.promise: Come, you who are blessed by my Father. Inherit the kingdom prepared for you since the foundation of the world.
promises.text: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

promises.promise: Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
promises.text: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

promises.promise: This is my body; this is my blood of the new lasting promise, which is poured out for many for remission of sins.
promises.text: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.” He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it, for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

promises.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid, for I know you seek Jesus who was crucified. He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Go tell his disciples he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.
promises.text: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified. He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying. Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

promises.promise: Jesus has all authority in heaven and on earth. He sends his followers to make disciples—and promises, “I am with you always, to the end of the age.”
promises.text: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth. Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

promises.promise: The time is fulfilled. God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.
promises.text: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom, and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

promises.promise: Child, your sins are forgiven.
promises.text: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

promises.promise: God promises that i came not to call the righteous, but sinners.
promises.text: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

promises.promise: He awoke and rebuked wind: Peace! Be still! Why are you so afraid?
promises.text: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm. He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

promises.promise: Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace. Be cured of your disease.
promises.text: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

promises.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid, only believe.
promises.text: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

promises.promise: Immediately he spoke: Cheer up! It is I! Do not be afraid.
promises.text: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

promises.promise: Deny yourself, take up your cross, and follow me. Whoever loses life for my sake and Good News’ will save it.
promises.text: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me. For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

promises.promise: If you can believe—all things are possible for the one who believes.
promises.text: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

promises.promise: Allow the little children to come to me. For God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these. Whoever doesn’t receive Kingdom as little child will not enter.
promises.text: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these. Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

promises.promise: With people it is impossible, but not with God—for all things are possible with God.
promises.text: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

promises.promise: Jesus promises that no one who has left home, family, or land for his sake and the Good News will fail to receive a hundred times as much now—and in the age to come, eternal life.
promises.text: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News, but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

promises.promise: Son of Man came not to be served but to serve. To give his life as a ransom for many.
promises.text: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

promises.promise: God promises that whoever says to mountain and doesn’t doubt but believes what he says happens—he will have whatever he says. Therefore all things you ask, believe you receive, and you will have them.
promises.text: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

promises.promise: Jesus says don’t be anxious beforehand what you will say; whatever given in that hour, say—for it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.
promises.text: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

promises.promise: You may be hated because you belong to Jesus—but anyone who endures to the end will be saved.
promises.text: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

promises.promise: Then they will see Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory. He will send angels gather elect from four winds.
promises.text: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory. Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

promises.promise: Heaven and earth will pass away, but Jesus’ words will never pass away.
promises.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

promises.promise: Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus the Nazarene who has been crucified. He has risen.
promises.text: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him! But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

promises.promise: The angel tells Mary not to be afraid—she has found favor with God. She will bear a son, Jesus, who will reign forever on David’s throne.
promises.text: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God. Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’ He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David, and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

promises.promise: Nothing God has spoken is impossible.
promises.text: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

promises.promise: Blessed is the one who believed. What the Lord has spoken to her will be fulfilled.
promises.text: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

promises.promise: My soul magnifies the Lord; he has looked at humble state; holy is his name. His mercy is for generations of people who fear him.
promises.text: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord. My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior, for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed. For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name. His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

promises.promise: He has put down princes and exalted lowly; filled hungry with good things; he has given help to Israel remembering mercy. As he spoke to Abraham forever.
promises.text: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly. He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty. He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy, as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

promises.promise: Blessed Lord God of Israel—he visited and redeemed; raised horn of salvation; mercy promised to fathers; remember holy lasting promise oath to Abraham—to grant we serve without fear in holiness.
promises.text: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people; and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old), salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us; to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant, the oath which he swore to Abraham our father, to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear, in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

promises.promise: You will go before Lord to prepare ways. Give knowledge of salvation by remission of sins—because of tender mercy, dawn from on high visit. Shine on darkness and death’s shadow.
promises.text: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways, to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins, because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us, to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

promises.promise: Do not be afraid—this is good news of great joy for all people. A Savior has been born: Christ the Lord.
promises.text: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people. For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

promises.promise: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace among those who receive his favor.
promises.text: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

promises.promise: Now you release your servant in peace; my eyes have seen your salvation prepared before all peoples. Light for revelation to Gentiles, glory of Israel.
promises.text: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace; for my eyes have seen your salvation, which you have prepared before the face of all peoples; a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

promises.promise: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he anointed me to preach good news to poor. Sent to heal brokenhearted, proclaim release to captives, recovering sight to blind, deliverance to oppressed, proclaim acceptable year of Lord.
promises.text: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed, and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

promises.promise: Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean. He stretched hand, touched: I want to. Be made clean. Leprosy departed.
promises.text: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.” He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

promises.promise: Friend, your sins are forgiven.
promises.text: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

promises.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are you poor—Kingdom is yours. Blessed who hunger—filled. Blessed who weep—laugh.
promises.text: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours. Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh. Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake. Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

promises.promise: Love enemies, do good, lend expecting nothing. Your reward will be great. You will be children of Most High—for he is kind toward unthankful and evil. Be merciful, even as your Father is merciful.
promises.text: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil. “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

promises.promise: Don’t judge and you won’t be judged; forgive and you will be forgiven. Give and it will be given. Good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over.
promises.text: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free. “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

promises.promise: Her many sins are forgiven—for she loved much. Jesus said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
promises.text: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.” He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

promises.promise: Daughter, take heart. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.
promises.text: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

promises.promise: God’s word to anxious hearts: don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.
promises.text: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

promises.promise: If anyone wants to follow Jesus, let them deny themselves, take up their cross daily, and follow him. Whoever loses their life for his sake will save it.
promises.text: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me. For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

promises.promise: God promises that he gives you authority to tread serpents and scorpions and over enemy’s power; nothing will by any means hurt you. Nevertheless rejoice that your names are written in heaven.
promises.text: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you. Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

promises.promise: God promises that i thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these from wise and understanding and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
promises.text: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

promises.promise: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who Son is except Father. Who Father is except Son, and he to whomever Son desires to reveal him.
promises.text: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

promises.promise: Ask and it will be given; seek and find; knock and opened. Everyone asking receives.
promises.text: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

promises.promise: If you know how to give good gifts, how much more will heavenly Father give Holy Spirit to people who ask him?
promises.text: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he? Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he? If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

promises.promise: Aren’t five sparrows sold for two coins, and not one forgotten by God? But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore don’t be afraid.
promises.text: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God. But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

promises.promise: God promises that everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before God’s angels.
promises.text: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

promises.promise: Jesus says don’t be anxious for life—food; nor body—clothing. Consider ravens: they don’t sow, God feeds them. How much more value are you than birds!
promises.text: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing. Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

promises.promise: Don’t seek what you will eat. Father knows you need these. Seek Kingdom and these will be added. Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
promises.text: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious. For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things. But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you. “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

promises.promise: Sell what you have and give to needy. Make purses that don’t grow old, treasure in heavens that doesn’t fail. For where treasure is, heart will be also.
promises.text: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys. For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

promises.promise: They will come from east, west, north, south, and sit in God’s Kingdom. some last will be first, and some first last.
promises.text: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom. Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

promises.promise: Shepherd leaves ninety-nine for lost sheep. When found, rejoices. Joy in heaven over one sinner who repenting, more than over ninety-nine righteous needing no repentance.
promises.text: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it? When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing. When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’ I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

promises.promise: Woman seeks lost coin. Rejoices with friends. Joy before angels of God over one sinner repenting.
promises.text: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it? When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’ Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

promises.promise: While still far off, father saw and was moved with compassion, ran, embraced, kissed. Bring best robe, ring, shoes. Kill fattened calf—this my son was dead and is alive again. Was lost and is found.
promises.text: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him. The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’ “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet. Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate; for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

promises.promise: Will not God avenge his chosen who cry day and night, though he is patient? I tell you he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when Son of Man comes, will he find faith on earth?
promises.text: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them? I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

promises.promise: God, be merciful to me, a sinner! I tell you, this man went down justified rather than the other. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.
promises.text: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’ I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

promises.promise: Allow little children to come. Kingdom of God belongs to such. Whoever doesn’t receive Kingdom as little child will in no way enter.
promises.text: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these. Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

promises.promise: The things which are impossible with people are possible with God.
promises.text: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

promises.promise: There is no one who has left house or wife or brothers or parents or children for God’s Kingdom’s sake who will not receive many times more in this time. In the world to come, eternal life.
promises.text: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake, who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

promises.promise: Today saving help has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham. For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.
promises.text: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham. For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

promises.promise: God promises that settle it in hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer, for he will give you a mouth and wisdom which all adversaries won’t be able to withstand or contradict.
promises.text: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer, for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

promises.promise: Not a hair of your head will perish. By enduring, you will gain your lives.
promises.text: And not a hair of your head will perish. “By your endurance you will win your lives.

promises.promise: They will see the Son of Man coming in cloud with power and great glory. When these things begin, look up and lift heads, because your redemption is near.
promises.text: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory. But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

promises.promise: Heaven and earth will pass away, but Jesus’ words will never pass away.
promises.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

promises.promise: This is my body given for you; this cup is new lasting promise in my blood, poured out for you.
promises.text: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.” Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

promises.promise: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.
promises.text: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

promises.promise: Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom. Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.
promises.text: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.” Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

promises.promise: Why do you seek the living among the dead? He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember how he spoke. Son of Man must be delivered, crucified, and third day rise again.
promises.text: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead? He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee, saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

promises.promise: Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise? See my hands and feet—it is I myself.
promises.text: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts? See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

promises.promise: God promises that thus it is written that Christ suffer and rise third day; repentance and remission of sins proclaimed in his name to all nations. he sends promise of Father on you; stay until clothed with power from on high.
promises.text: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day, and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem. You are witnesses of these things. Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

promises.promise: As many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to people who believe in his name—born not of blood nor will of flesh nor man, but of God.
promises.text: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

promises.promise: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We have seen his glory—glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
promises.text: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

promises.promise: From Jesus’ fullness we have all received grace upon grace. The law came through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
promises.text: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace. For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

promises.promise: the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
promises.text: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

promises.promise: Unless one is born anew, he cannot see God’s Kingdom. Unless born of water and Spirit, he cannot enter God’s Kingdom.
promises.text: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.” Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?” Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

promises.promise: As Moses lifted up serpent in wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
promises.text: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

promises.promise: God loved the world so much that he gave his one and only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not be lost but have eternal life.
promises.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life. For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

promises.promise: God promises that anyone who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
promises.text: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

promises.promise: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son will not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.
promises.text: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

promises.promise: God promises that everyone who drinks this water will thirst again, but whoever drinks of the water that he will give will never thirst; the water he gives will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.
promises.text: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again, but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

promises.promise: True worshipers will worship Father in spirit and truth, for Father seeks such. God is spirit, and people who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.
promises.text: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers. God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

promises.promise: God promises that anyone who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
promises.text: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

promises.promise: Hour comes when all in tombs will hear his voice and come out—people who have done good to resurrection of life.
promises.text: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

promises.promise: God says he is the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.
promises.text: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

promises.promise: God promises that all those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me he will in no way throw out.
promises.text: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

promises.promise: God promises that this is will of Father: of all he has given me I should lose nothing but raise it up at last day. Everyone who sees Son and believes has eternal life; he will raise him up at last day.
promises.text: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day. This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

promises.promise: God promises that most certainly, he who believes in me has eternal life. he is the bread of life.
promises.text: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life. I am the bread of life.

promises.promise: God says he is the living bread from heaven; if anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. The bread I will give is my flesh for life of world.
promises.text: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

promises.promise: God promises that he who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and he will raise him up at last day. He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
promises.text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day. For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed. He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

promises.promise: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit. Are life.
promises.text: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

promises.promise: Jesus says, if anyone is thirsty, come to him and drink. Whoever believes in him will have rivers of living water flowing from within.
promises.text: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink! He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

promises.promise: God says he is the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.
promises.text: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

promises.promise: If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples. You will know the truth. The truth will make you free.
promises.text: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples. You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

promises.promise: God promises that everyone who commits sin is bondservant of sin. If the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
promises.text: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin. A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever. If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

promises.promise: Jesus promises that anyone who keeps his word will never see death.
promises.text: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

promises.promise: God promises that i must work works of him who sent me while it is day. When night comes, no one can work. While he is in the world, he is the light of the world.
promises.text: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work. While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

promises.promise: God says he is the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
promises.text: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture. The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

promises.promise: God says he is the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
promises.text: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

promises.promise: God says he is the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own; even as Father knows me and I know Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
promises.text: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own; even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

promises.promise: God promises that my sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. he gives eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
promises.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand. My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

promises.promise: God promises that i and the Father are one.
promises.text: I and the Father are one.”

promises.promise: God says he is the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies. Whoever lives and believes in me will never die.
promises.text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies. Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

promises.promise: Jesus asks, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
promises.text: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

promises.promise: Unless a grain of wheat falls into earth and dies, it remains alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit. He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
promises.text: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit. He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

promises.promise: God promises that and I, if he is lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.
promises.text: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

promises.promise: God promises that he has come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
promises.text: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
promises.context: Light so not remain in dark.

promises.promise: God promises that a new commandment: love one another. Just as he has loved you, you also love one another. By this everyone will know you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.
promises.text: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another. By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

promises.promise: God promises that don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
promises.text: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me. In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you. If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

promises.promise: God says he is the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
promises.text: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

promises.promise: God promises that he who believes in me, works I do he will do also; greater works—because I go to Father. Whatever you will ask in his name, he will do, that Father may be glorified in Son. If you will ask anything in his name, he will do it.
promises.text: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father. Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son. If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

promises.promise: God promises that if you love me, keep my commandments. he will pray Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever: the Spirit of truth. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
promises.text: If you love me, keep my commandments. I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

promises.promise: God says he will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
promises.text: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

promises.promise: God promises that because I live, you will live also. In that day you will know that he is in my Father, you in me, and I in you.
promises.text: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also. In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

promises.promise: God promises that one who has my commandments and keeps them is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and he will love him, and will reveal myself to him.
promises.text: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

promises.promise: If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him. We will come to him and make our home with him.
promises.text: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

promises.promise: The Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom Father will send in my name, will teach you all things. Will remind you of all that I said to you.
promises.text: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

promises.promise: Jesus gives you his peace—not like the world’s peace. Do not let your heart be troubled or afraid.
promises.text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

promises.promise: God says he is the true vine, and my Father is the farmer. Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
promises.text: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer. Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

promises.promise: God promises that remain in me, and I in you. As branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in vine, so neither can you unless you remain in me. he is the vine.
promises.text: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me. I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

promises.promise: If you remain in me. My words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you. In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit.
promises.text: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you. “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

promises.promise: God promises that even as Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love. If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love.
promises.text: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love. If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love. I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

promises.promise: God promises that this is my commandment, that you love one another, even as he has loved you. Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
promises.text: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you. Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

promises.promise: God promises that no longer do I call you servants… but he has called you friends. You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain—that whatever you will ask of Father in his name, he may give it to you.
promises.text: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you. You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
promises.context: Friends; chosen to bear lasting fruit.

promises.promise: God promises that when the Counselor has come, whom he will send to you from Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from Father, he will testify about me.
promises.text: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

promises.promise: God promises that it is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go, Counselor won’t come; but if I go, he will send him to you.
promises.text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

promises.promise: When he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth. He will not speak from himself, but whatever he hears he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming. He will glorify me.
promises.text: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming. He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

promises.promise: God promises that you will weep and lament, but world will rejoice; you will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy. You have sorrow now, but he will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away.
promises.text: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy. A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world. Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

promises.promise: Most certainly, whatever you may ask of Father in my name, he will give it to you. Until now you asked nothing in my name. Ask. You will receive, that your joy may be made full.
promises.text: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you. Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

promises.promise: The Father himself loves you, because you have loved me. Have believed that I came from God.
promises.text: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

promises.promise: God promises that he has told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! he has overcome the world.
promises.text: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
promises.context: Overcome the world; peace in me.

promises.promise: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God. Him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
promises.text: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

promises.promise: Jesus prays, “Holy Father, keep them in your name that you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are one.”
promises.text: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

promises.promise: God promises that i pray not that you would take them from world, but that you would keep them from evil one. Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
promises.text: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one. They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world. Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
promises.context: Kept from evil; sanctified in truth.

promises.promise: God promises that i pray for those also who believe through their word—that they may all be one… I in them, you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that world may know you sent me and loved them even as you loved me.
promises.text: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word, that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me. The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one, I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

promises.promise: God promises that father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where he is, that they may see his glory which you have given me, for you loved me before foundation of world.
promises.text: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

promises.promise: God promises that i made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.
promises.text: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
promises.context: Love in them; I in them.

promises.promise: God promises that peace be to you. As Father has sent me, even so he sends you.
promises.text: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.” When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord. Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

promises.promise: He breathed on them: Receive the Holy Spirit! If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.
promises.text: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit! If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

promises.promise: Don’t be unbelieving, but believing. Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are people who have not seen and have believed.
promises.text: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.” Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!” Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
promises.context: Blessed who haven’t seen yet believe.

promises.promise: These are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God. That believing you may have life in his name.
promises.text: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
promises.context: Written for life in his name.

promises.promise: You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria. To the uttermost parts of the earth.
promises.text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
promises.context: Jesus’ words before he returned to heaven.

promises.promise: God promises that in the last days he will pour out his Spirit on all flesh; sons and daughters will prophesy; young men see visions; old men dream; on servants I pour out his Spirit.
promises.text: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams. Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
promises.context: Peter explains the Spirit’s coming with Joel’s words.

promises.promise: God promises that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.
promises.text: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
promises.context: Anyone who calls on the Lord can be saved.

promises.promise: Repent and be baptized in Jesus’ name for forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the Holy Spirit. The promise is to you, your children, and all who are far off. Everyone the Lord calls.
promises.text: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit. For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
promises.context: Forgiveness and the Spirit are offered widely.

promises.promise: Turn back to God so your sins may be wiped away. Times of refreshing will come from the Lord’s presence, until God restores all things.
promises.text: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord, and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before, whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
promises.context: Turning back to God brings refreshment.

promises.promise: There is salvation in no one else. No other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved.
promises.text: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

promises.promise: God doesn’t show favoritism; in every nation the one who fears him. Works righteousness is acceptable to him.
promises.text: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism; but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

promises.promise: Everyone who believes in Jesus receives forgiveness of sins through his name.
promises.text: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

promises.promise: Through this man remission of sins is proclaimed; by him everyone who believes is made right with God from all things the law of Moses could not justify.
promises.text: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins; and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

promises.promise: Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ. You will be saved, you and your household.
promises.text: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

promises.promise: God promises that don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent; he is with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for he has many people in this city.
promises.text: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent; for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

promises.promise: God promises that he sends you to open eyes, turn from darkness to light and from Satan’s power to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among the sanctified by faith in me.
promises.text: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you, to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

promises.promise: God says he is not ashamed of the Good News—it is God’s power of salvation to everyone who believes. In it God’s righteousness is revealed from faith to faith; the righteous shall live by faith.
promises.text: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek. For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”

promises.promise: Apart from law, God’s righteousness is revealed through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. All have sinned and fall short. Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption in Christ Jesus.
promises.text: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets; even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction, for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God; being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

promises.promise: God set forth Jesus as a mercy seat through faith in his blood—that he might be just. The justifier of the one who has faith in Jesus.
promises.text: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance; to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

promises.promise: To anyone who doesn’t work but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, faith is accounted for righteousness.
promises.text: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

promises.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are those whose sins are forgiven, whose sins are covered. Blessed is the one whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.
promises.text: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered. Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

promises.promise: The promise is of faith according to grace, sure to all the children—before God who gives life to the dead and calls things that are not as though they were.
promises.text: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all. As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
promises.context: Sure promise; life to the dead.

promises.promise: Abraham grew strong through faith, fully assured that what God had promised he was also able to perform. Credited as righteousness.
promises.text: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God, and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform. Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

promises.promise: Justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ. Through him we have access into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
promises.text: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ; through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
promises.context: Peace with God; hope of glory.

promises.promise: We rejoice in sufferings—suffering produces perseverance, character, hope. And hope doesn’t disappoint, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit given to us.
promises.text: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance; and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope; and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

promises.promise: While we were still weak, Christ died for the ungodly. God shows his love for us in this: while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
promises.text: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly. For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die. But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

promises.promise: Since we have been made right with God by Jesus’ blood, we will be saved from wrath through him. If we were reconciled to God by his Son’s death while we were enemies, how much more will we be saved by his life.
promises.text: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him. For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life. Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

promises.promise: Those who receive God’s abundant grace and the gift of righteousness will reign in life through Jesus Christ.
promises.text: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

promises.promise: Where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly. So grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
promises.text: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly, that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

promises.promise: Buried with him through baptism into death, we might walk in newness of life. United with him in death, we will also be part of his resurrection.
promises.text: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life. For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

promises.promise: Sin will not have care for you, for you are not under law but under grace.
promises.text: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

promises.promise: The wages of sin is death, but God’s free gift is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
promises.text: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

promises.promise: There is therefore now no condemnation to people who are in Christ Jesus. The law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
promises.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit. For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

promises.promise: The mind set on the flesh leads to death, but the mind set on the Spirit is life and peace.
promises.text: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

promises.promise: You are in the Spirit if God’s Spirit lives in you. If Christ is in you, your spirit is alive because of righteousness. And the Spirit who raised Jesus will also give life to your mortal bodies.
