promises.text: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his. If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness. But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

promises.promise: As many as are led by the Spirit of God are children of God. You didn’t receive a spirit of bondage again to fear, but the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, Abba! Father!
promises.text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God. For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!” The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
promises.context: Adoption; Abba; no spirit of fear.

promises.promise: If children, then heirs. Heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
promises.text: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

promises.promise: The sufferings of this present time are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed to us.
promises.text: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

promises.promise: The Spirit helps our weaknesses. We don’t know how to pray as we ought, but the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings that can’t be uttered, according to God.
promises.text: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered. He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

promises.promise: God promises that he works all things together for good for those who love him and are called according to his purpose.
promises.text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

promises.promise: Whom he foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to his Son’s image. Whom he predestined he also called. Whom he called he also justified.
promises.text: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers. Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

promises.promise: If God is for us, who can be against us? He who didn’t spare his own Son but delivered him up for us all. How will he not also with him freely give us all things?
promises.text: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us? He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
promises.context: God for us; freely give all.

promises.promise: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies. Who condemns?
promises.text: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies. Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

promises.promise: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ. Tribulation, anguish, persecution, famine, nakedness, danger, or sword? In all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
promises.text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword? Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.” No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

promises.promise: Nothing can separate you from God’s love in Christ Jesus—not death, life, angels, powers, or anything else in all creation.
promises.text: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
promises.context: Nothing can separate from God’s love.

promises.promise: If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. Everyone who believes in him will not be put to shame.
promises.text: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation. For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”

promises.promise: There is no distinction between Jew and Greek. The same Lord is Lord of all and rich to all who call on him. Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.
promises.text: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him. For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

promises.promise: God’s gifts and his calling are never taken back.
promises.text: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

promises.promise: Present your bodies a living sacrifice. Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so you may prove God’s good, well-pleasing, and perfect will.
promises.text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service. Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

promises.promise: Rejoice in hope, be patient in trouble, and keep on praying.
promises.text: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

promises.promise: Do not take revenge; leave room for God’s justice. Vengeance belongs to the Lord, and he will repay.
promises.text: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
promises.context: Paul’s call to lived worship includes releasing personal vengeance into God’s hands.

promises.promise: Whatever was written in the past was written to teach us, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
promises.text: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

promises.promise: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
promises.text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
promises.context: God of hope fills joy and peace.

promises.promise: God will keep you firm to the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is faithful—he called you into fellowship with his Son.
promises.text: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

promises.promise: The word of the cross is foolishness to people who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
promises.text: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

promises.promise: God chose the foolish, weak. He also base things of the world to put to shame the wise and strong—that no flesh should boast before God.
promises.text: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong. God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist, that no flesh should boast before God.

promises.promise: Things which eye didn’t see and ear didn’t hear, and which didn’t enter into the heart of man, God has prepared for people who love him. But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit.
promises.text: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.” But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
promises.context: Prepared for those who love him.

promises.promise: We have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, so that we may understand what God has freely given us.
promises.text: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

promises.promise: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you? If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him. For God’s temple is holy, which you are.
promises.text: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you? If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

promises.promise: God raised up the Lord. Will also raise us up by his power.
promises.text: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

promises.promise: Your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who is in you and whom you have from God. You are not your own—you were bought with a price.
promises.text: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own, for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

promises.promise: No temptation has seized you except what is common to people. God is faithful. He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear, and he will provide a way out so you can endure.
promises.text: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

promises.promise: There are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit. Various servings, same Lord. Various workings, same God who works all in all. But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.
promises.text: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit. There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord. There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all. But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

promises.promise: Love is patient and kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love bears, believes, hopes, and endures all things. Love never fails.
promises.text: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud, doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil; doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things. Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

promises.promise: God promises that now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then he will know fully, even as I was also fully known. Now faith, hope, and love remain—these three.
promises.text: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known. But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

promises.promise: Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, was buried. Was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures.
promises.text: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

promises.promise: But now Christ has been raised from the dead, the first fruits of people who are asleep. For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
promises.text: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep. For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man. For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

promises.promise: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed. In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. The trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
promises.text: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed, in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

promises.promise: Death is swallowed up in victory. Where, O death, is your sting? Thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
promises.text: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.” “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?” The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law. But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

promises.promise: Therefore, beloved friends, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
promises.text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

promises.promise: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous!
promises.text: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong! Let all that you do be done in love.

promises.promise: God is the Father of mercies and God of all comfort. He comforts you in every trouble so you can comfort others.
promises.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

promises.promise: Just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also our comfort overflows through Christ.
promises.text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

promises.promise: However many promises God has made, they are “Yes” in Christ. And through him we say “Amen” to the glory of God.
promises.text: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
promises.context: All God’s promises Yes in Christ.

promises.promise: It is God who makes us stand firm in Christ. He anointed us, set his seal of ownership on us, and put his Spirit in our hearts as a deposit.
promises.text: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God, who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

promises.promise: Now the Lord is the Spirit. And where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty. We all, with unveiled face seeing the Lord’s glory as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
promises.text: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty. But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

promises.promise: God, who said “Light will shine out of darkness,” has shone in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory in the face of Jesus Christ.
promises.text: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

promises.promise: We carry God’s treasure in fragile jars of clay, so the power is clearly his. We may be pressed and confused, but we are not crushed, forsaken, or destroyed.
promises.text: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves. We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair; pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
promises.context: Clay vessels; not crushed or forsaken.

promises.promise: Therefore we don’t faint. Though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day. For our light suffering, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory.
promises.text: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day. For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory, while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
promises.context: Renewed day by day; eternal weight of glory.

promises.promise: We know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God—an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
promises.text: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

promises.promise: God himself prepared us for this, and he gave us the Spirit as a deposit guaranteeing what is to come.
promises.text: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

promises.promise: We walk by faith, not by sight.
promises.text: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

promises.promise: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. all things have become new.
promises.text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

promises.promise: All things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation. Namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses.
promises.text: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation; namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

promises.promise: God made him who knew no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
promises.text: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

promises.promise: now is the acceptable time. now is the day of salvation.
promises.text: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

promises.promise: God says he will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God, and they will be my people. I will be to you a Father, and you will be to me sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.
promises.text: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.” Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you. I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

promises.promise: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus.
promises.text: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

promises.promise: God promises that anyone who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully. God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
promises.text: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully. Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver. And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

promises.promise: God promises that anyone who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness. You will be enriched in everything for all generosity.
promises.text: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness, you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

promises.promise: God promises that he has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore he will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me. When he is weak, then he is strong.
promises.text: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me. Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

promises.promise: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted.
promises.text: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
promises.context: God of love and peace with you.

promises.promise: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God. The fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
promises.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

promises.promise: God promises that he has been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
promises.text: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
promises.context: Christ lives in me; loved me.

promises.promise: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, so that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the nations through Christ Jesus—and so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.
promises.text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,” that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

promises.promise: You are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus. For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ. There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
promises.text: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus. For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ. There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus. If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

promises.promise: When the time was right, God sent his Son so we could be adopted as his children. You are no longer a slave but a child—and if a child, then an heir through God.
promises.text: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law, that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children. And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!” So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

promises.promise: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free. Don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
promises.text: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

promises.promise: You were called to freedom… through love be servants to one another. For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”.
promises.text: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another. For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

promises.promise: Walk by the Spirit. You won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh. If you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
promises.text: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh. For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire. But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

promises.promise: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness. Self-control. Against such things there is no law.
promises.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

promises.promise: Bear one another’s burdens. So fulfill the law of Christ.
promises.text: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

promises.promise: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap. Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we do not give up.
promises.text: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap. For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life. Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
promises.context: Reap in due season; don’t give up.

promises.promise: God has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing. In love he chose us to be holy and adopted us as his children, to the praise of his glorious grace.
promises.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ, even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love, having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire, to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

promises.promise: In Jesus we have redemption through his blood—the forgiveness of sins—according to the riches of God’s grace, which he poured out on us.
promises.text: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

promises.promise: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation. In whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit, who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
promises.text: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit, who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
promises.context: Sealed with Spirit; pledge of inheritance.

promises.promise: But God, rich in mercy and great in love, made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in sins. By grace you have been saved—and he shows the riches of his kindness forever.
promises.text: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved— and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus, that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
promises.context: Rich in mercy; made alive; seated with Christ.

promises.promise: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves. It is the gift of God, not of works, that no one would boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we would walk in them.
promises.text: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, that no one would boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

promises.promise: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ. For he is our peace, who made both one. Broke down the middle wall of separation.
promises.text: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ. For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
promises.context: Far off made near; he is our peace.

promises.promise: Through Jesus we both have access to the Father by one Spirit. So you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with God’s people and members of his household.
promises.text: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father. So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,
promises.context: Access to Father; household of God.

promises.promise: Being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone. In whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord. In whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
promises.text: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone; in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord; in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
promises.context: Habitation of God in the Spirit.

promises.promise: In Christ we have boldness and confident access to God through faith in him.
promises.text: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

promises.promise: God strengthens you with power through his Spirit in your inner person, so Christ may live in your heart by faith—and you may know his love that surpasses knowledge.
promises.text: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person, that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love, may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth, and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
promises.context: Christ dwells; know surpassing love; filled with fullness.

promises.promise: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever. Amen.
promises.text: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
promises.context: Able to do above all we ask or think.

promises.promise: There is one body and one Spirit—just as you were called to one hope—one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
promises.text: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling, one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

promises.promise: Put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit. Be renewed in the spirit of your mind, and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
promises.text: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit, and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind, and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

promises.promise: “Be angry. Don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath, and don’t give place to the devil.
promises.text: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath, and don’t give place to the devil.
promises.context: Be angry without sin; do not give the devil a foothold.

promises.promise: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other, just as God in Christ forgave you.
promises.text: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

promises.promise: Be imitators of God, as beloved children. Walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us.
promises.text: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children. Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

promises.promise: You were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light—for the fruit of the light is goodness, righteousness, and truth.
promises.text: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light, for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

promises.promise: Awake, you who sleep. Arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.
promises.text: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

promises.promise: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power. Put on the whole armor of God, so you can stand against the devil’s schemes.
promises.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might. Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

promises.promise: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day. Having done all, to stand.
promises.text: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

promises.promise: Above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one. And take the helmet of saving help and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
promises.text: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one. And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
promises.context: Shield of faith; helmet of salvation.

promises.promise: God who began a good work in you will carry it through to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
promises.text: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
promises.context: He will complete the good work.

promises.promise: For to me to live is Christ. To die is gain.
promises.text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
promises.context: To live is Christ; to die is gain.

promises.promise: It is God who works in you—giving you both the desire and the power to do what pleases him.
promises.text: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
promises.context: God works in you to will and work.

promises.promise: Our citizenship is in heaven. We wait for a Savior from there—the Lord Jesus Christ—who will transform our lowly bodies to be like his glorious body.
promises.text: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ, who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

promises.promise: God promises that rejoice in the Lord always! Again he will say, Rejoice! Let your gentleness be known to all men.
promises.text: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!” Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

promises.promise: God invites you not to stay stuck in worry. Bring everything to him in prayer with thanks—and his peace will guard your heart and mind in Christ Jesus.
promises.text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
promises.context: Bring your worries to God in prayer.

promises.promise: Whatever things are true, honorable, just, pure, lovely, of good report… think about these things. The things which you learned… do these things. The God of peace will be with you.
promises.text: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things. Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

promises.promise: God promises that he has learned in whatever state he is, to be content in it. I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
promises.text: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it. I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need. I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

promises.promise: God promises to supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
promises.text: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

promises.promise: God strengthens you with all power according to his glorious might, so you may have great endurance and patience with joy, giving thanks to the Father who qualifies you to share in the inheritance of his people in the light.
promises.text: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy, giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

promises.promise: Who delivered us out of the power of darkness. Translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love, in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
promises.text: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love, in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

promises.promise: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him. Through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
promises.text: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him, and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

promises.promise: Once you were alienated from God and enemies in your minds because of evil deeds. But now he has reconciled you by Christ’s body through death, to present you holy and blameless in his sight.
promises.text: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds, yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

promises.promise: God was pleased to make known among the nations the glorious riches of this mystery: Christ in you, the hope of glory.
promises.text: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
promises.context: Christ in you, the hope of glory.

promises.promise: Just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live in him—rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
promises.text: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him, rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
promises.context: Rooted and built up in him.

promises.promise: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily. In him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
promises.text: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily, and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
promises.context: In him you are made full.

promises.promise: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses, wiping out the handwriting in instructions that was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
promises.text: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses, wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
promises.context: Made alive; handwriting nailed to cross.

promises.promise: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God. Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth. For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
promises.text: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God. Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth. For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God. When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
promises.context: Life hidden with Christ; revealed in glory.

promises.promise: Put on, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance; bearing with one another, and forgiving each other… even as Christ forgave you, so you also do. Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
promises.text: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance; bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do. Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection. And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
promises.context: Chosen, holy, beloved; peace rule; love.

promises.promise: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly. In all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord. Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
promises.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord. Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
promises.context: Word dwell richly; all in Jesus’ name.

promises.promise: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen. That our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance.
promises.text: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen, and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

promises.promise: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone. May he strengthen your hearts so you will be blameless and holy before our God and Father when Jesus comes.
promises.text: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you, to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

promises.promise: We don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning people who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him people who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
promises.text: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope. For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.
promises.context: Grief with hope; God will bring them.

promises.promise: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first, then we who are alive… will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.
promises.text: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first, then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever. Therefore comfort one another with these words.
promises.context: Caught up; with the Lord forever.

promises.promise: For God did not appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ, who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
promises.text: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ, who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
promises.context: Appointed to salvation; live with him.

promises.promise: Always rejoice. Pray without stopping. Give thanks in everything—for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
promises.text: Always rejoice. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

promises.promise: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul. Body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
promises.text: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

promises.promise: Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay suffering to those who afflict you, and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels.
promises.text: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you, and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

promises.promise: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for saving help through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth, to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
promises.text: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth, to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
promises.context: Loved; chosen for salvation and glory.

promises.promise: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself. God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace, comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.
promises.text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace, comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

promises.promise: The Lord is faithful. He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
promises.text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

promises.promise: May the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with you all.
promises.text: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
promises.context: Lord of peace; with you all.

promises.promise: God promises that the grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus. The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom he is chief.
promises.text: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus. The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

promises.promise: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior, who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth. For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the person Christ Jesus, who gave himself as a ransom for all.
promises.text: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior, who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth. For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus, who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,
promises.context: Desires all saved; one mediator; ransom.

promises.promise: Godliness is profitable for all things, having promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come. For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of people who believe.
promises.text: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come. This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance. For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
promises.context: Promise of life now and to come.

promises.promise: But godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into the world. We certainly can’t carry anything out. But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
promises.text: But godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out. But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

promises.promise: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called. You confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
promises.text: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

promises.promise: Charge people who are rich… that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy… laying up for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
promises.text: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy; that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share; laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
promises.context: Hope on living God who richly provides.

promises.promise: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love. Self-control.
promises.text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

promises.promise: God saved us and called us with a holy calling—not because of our works, but because of his own purpose and grace given in Christ Jesus.
promises.text: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal, but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
promises.context: Saved and called by grace; abolished death.

promises.promise: God promises that for this cause I also suffer these things. Yet he is not ashamed, for I know him whom he has believed, and he is persuaded that he is able to guard that which he has committed to him against that day.
promises.text: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
promises.context: He is able to guard what I committed.

promises.promise: Faithful is the saying: For if we died with him, we will also live with him. If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
promises.text: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him. If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us. If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

promises.promise: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”.
promises.text: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
promises.context: The Lord knows those who are his.

promises.promise: The holy Scriptures can make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus. All Scripture is God-breathed and useful—so you may be complete and equipped for every good work.
promises.text: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus. Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness, that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
promises.context: Scriptures make wise for salvation; equip.

promises.promise: God promises that he has fought the good fight. he has finished the course. he has kept the faith.
promises.text: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith. From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
promises.context: Crown of righteousness for all who love his appearing.

promises.promise: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me… The Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever. Amen.
promises.text: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion. And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
promises.context: Lord stood by; will preserve for kingdom.

promises.promise: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness, in hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
promises.text: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness, in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
promises.context: God who can’t lie promised eternal life.

promises.promise: God’s grace has appeared, bringing salvation for all people. It trains us to live upright lives while we wait for our great God and Savior Jesus Christ, who gave himself to redeem us.
promises.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men, instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age; looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ, who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
promises.context: Grace brings salvation; blessed hope; purify a people.

promises.promise: When God’s kindness and love appeared, he saved us—not by our works of righteousness, but by his mercy—through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
promises.text: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared, not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit, whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior; that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
promises.context: Saved by mercy; Spirit poured; heirs of eternal life.

promises.promise: Paul thanks God for Philemon’s love and faith. The hearts of the saints have been refreshed through him—a picture of how love builds up God’s people.
promises.text: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers, hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints, that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus. For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
promises.context: Love refreshes hearts of the saints.

promises.promise: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance. Upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high.
promises.text: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

promises.promise: Jesus shared our flesh and blood so that through death he might break the power of the devil and free those who lived in fear of death.
promises.text: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil, and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

promises.promise: He was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people. For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help people who are tempted.
promises.text: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people. For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
promises.context: Merciful high priest able to help the tempted.

promises.promise: Christ is faithful as a Son over God’s house. We are his house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope we boast in.
promises.text: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
promises.context: We are his house; hold hope firm.

promises.promise: There remains a Sabbath rest for the people of God. Anyone who enters God’s rest also rests from their own works, just as God did. So make every effort to enter that rest.
promises.text: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God. For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his. Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

promises.promise: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart. There is no creature that is hidden from his sight.
promises.text: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart. There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

promises.promise: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession. For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
promises.text: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession. For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin. Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
promises.context: Throne of grace; help in time of need.

promises.promise: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints. Still do serve them.
promises.text: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
promises.context: God will not forget your labor of love.

promises.promise: God wanted the heirs of the promise to be sure, so he confirmed it with an oath. We have this hope as a strong and steady anchor for the soul.
promises.text: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath, that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us. This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

promises.promise: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable. Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost people who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
promises.text: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable. Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
promises.context: Able to save to the uttermost; forever intercedes.

promises.promise: God promises that this is the lasting promise that he will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord: he will put my laws into their mind; he will also write them on their heart. he will be their God, and they will be his people.
promises.text: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people. They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest. For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
promises.context: New lasting promise; laws on heart; sins remembered no more.

promises.promise: Jesus entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, not by the blood of goats and calves—and so he obtained eternal redemption.
promises.text: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

promises.promise: How much more will the blood of Christ—who through the eternal Spirit offered himself unblemished to God—cleanse our conscience from dead works to serve the living God.
promises.text: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

promises.promise: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment, so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save people who are eagerly waiting for him.
promises.text: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment, so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.
promises.context: Will appear to save those waiting.

promises.promise: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being made holy.
promises.text: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

promises.promise: God promises that this is the lasting promise that he will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “he will put my laws on their heart, he will also write them on their mind;” then he says, “he will remember their sins and their sins no more.
promises.text: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says, “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
promises.context: God promises to forget sins he has forgiven.

promises.promise: Because of Jesus’ blood, we have boldness to enter God’s holy presence. So draw near with a true heart, in full assurance of faith.
promises.text: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus, by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh, and having a great priest over God’s house, let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

promises.promise: Let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering. For he who promised is faithful.
promises.text: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

promises.promise: Therefore do not throw away your boldness, which has a great reward. For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
promises.text: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward. For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

promises.promise: Faith is being sure of what we hope for, and certain of what we do not see.
promises.text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

promises.promise: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of people who seek him.
promises.text: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
promises.context: God rewards those who seek him.

promises.promise: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive. She bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
promises.text: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

promises.promise: Surrounded by so many witnesses, let us run with endurance the race set before us, looking to Jesus—the one who begins and finishes our faith.
promises.text: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
promises.context: Run looking to Jesus, author and perfecter.

promises.promise: My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him. For whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.
promises.text: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him; for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
promises.context: Whom the Lord loves he disciplines.

promises.promise: He disciplines us for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness. All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous. Yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
promises.text: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness. All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

promises.promise: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that cannot be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe.
promises.text: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

promises.promise: God promises, “I will never leave you or forsake you.” So you can say with confidence that the Lord is your helper.
promises.text: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
promises.context: God will never leave you; he is your helper.

promises.promise: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today. Forever.
promises.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

promises.promise: The God of peace, who raised the great Shepherd Jesus, will equip you with everything good to do his will—working in you what pleases him.
promises.text: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus, make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
promises.context: God of peace; great shepherd; eternal lasting promise; complete you.

promises.promise: Count it all joy when you face trials of many kinds. You know that the testing of your faith produces endurance—and endurance must finish its work so you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
promises.text: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance. Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

promises.promise: If you lack wisdom, ask God. He gives generously to all without finding fault—and it will be given to you.
promises.text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him. But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

promises.promise: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to people who love him.
promises.text: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
promises.context: Crown of life promised to those who love him.

promises.promise: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, who does not change like shifting shadows. He chose to give us birth through the word of truth.
promises.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow. Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
promises.context: Every good gift; Father of lights; birth by word.

promises.promise: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger. For the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
promises.text: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger; for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
promises.context: Swift to hear, slow to speak and anger.

promises.promise: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose people who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to people who love him?
promises.text: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
promises.context: Heirs of the Kingdom promised to lovers of God.

promises.promise: So speak and so do as people who are to be judged by the law of freedom. For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
promises.text: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom. For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

promises.promise: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
promises.text: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you. Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
promises.context: More grace; draw near and he draws near.

promises.promise: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.
promises.text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

promises.promise: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain. You also be patient.
promises.text: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain. You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
