promises.promise: we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
promises.text: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
promises.context: Lord full of compassion and mercy.

promises.promise: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful?
promises.text: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises. Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord; and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven. Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

promises.promise: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy became our father again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you, who by the power of God are.
promises.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you, who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

promises.promise: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials, that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory. Honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
promises.text: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials, that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
promises.context: Trials prove faith; praise at revelation.

promises.promise: Whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory, receiving the result of your faith, the saving help of your souls.
promises.text: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory, receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

promises.promise: You were redeemed—not with perishable things like silver or gold, but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.
promises.text: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers, but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

promises.promise: You have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God. People are like grass, but the word of the Lord endures forever.
promises.text: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever. For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls; but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

promises.promise: Coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious. You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood… Because it is contained in Scripture, “I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”.
promises.text: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious. You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ. Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

promises.promise: You are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God’s special possession—that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light. Once you were not a people, but now you are God’s people.
promises.text: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light. In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

promises.promise: Jesus himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness. By his wounds you have been healed. You were like sheep going astray, but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
promises.text: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds. For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
promises.context: Bore sins; healed by wounds; returned to Shepherd.

promises.promise: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous, not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult. But instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
promises.text: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous, not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
promises.context: Called to bless; inherit a blessing.

promises.promise: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against people who do evil.
promises.text: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
promises.context: Eyes on righteous; ears open to prayer.

promises.promise: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, those who walk with God for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit.
promises.text: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
promises.context: Righteous for unrighteous; bring you to God.

promises.promise: Beloved, do not be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you. But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
promises.text: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you. But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
promises.context: Share sufferings; rejoice at glory’s revelation.

promises.promise: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
promises.text: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

promises.promise: God cares for you. Humble yourself under his hand, and cast all your worries on him—he holds you.
promises.text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time, casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
promises.context: You can cast your worries on God—he cares.

promises.promise: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
promises.text: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour. Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings. But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
promises.context: God of all grace will perfect and strengthen after suffering.

promises.promise: Seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue, by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having.
promises.text: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue, by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
promises.context: Precious promises; partakers of divine nature.

promises.promise: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble. For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
promises.text: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble. For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

promises.promise: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day. The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness. But he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
promises.text: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day. The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
promises.context: Not slow; patient; not wishing any perish.

promises.promise: But according to his promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness lives.
promises.text: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
promises.context: New heavens and new earth promised.

promises.promise: God promises to be your safe place. When you call on him, he is like a strong rock and shield who protects and rescues you.
promises.text: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all. If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth. But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
promises.context: Walk in light; blood cleanses from all sin.

promises.promise: If we confess our sins, God is faithful and just to forgive us and to cleanse us from all wrong.
promises.text: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us. If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
promises.context: Confess; faithful to forgive and cleanse.

promises.promise: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous. And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins. Not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
promises.text: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous. And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
promises.context: Counselor with the Father; atoning sacrifice.

promises.promise: God promises that i write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
promises.text: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
promises.context: Sins forgiven for his name’s sake.

promises.promise: The world and its desires are passing away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.
promises.text: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
promises.context: Doer’s of God’s will remain forever.

promises.promise: This is what he promised us—eternal life.
promises.text: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

promises.promise: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him. Beloved, now we are children of God.
promises.text: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him. Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
promises.context: Called children; we will be like him.

promises.promise: God promises that anyone who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
promises.text: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
promises.context: Son revealed to destroy devil’s works.

promises.promise: This is how we know what love is: Jesus laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers and sisters.
promises.text: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
promises.context: He laid down his life for us.

promises.promise: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him, because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart. Knows all things.
promises.text: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him, because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

promises.promise: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God. So whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
promises.text: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God; so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

promises.promise: You are of God, little children, and have overcome—because the One in you is greater than the one in the world.
promises.text: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

promises.promise: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God. He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love. By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
promises.text: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God. He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love. By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him. In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
promises.context: God is love; he loved us first.

promises.promise: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him. In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
promises.text: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him. In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world. There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

promises.promise: We love because he first loved us.
promises.text: We love him, because he first loved us.

promises.promise: Everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith. Who overcomes the world? The one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
promises.text: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith. Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

promises.promise: God promises that the testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
promises.text: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life. These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
promises.context: Know that you have eternal life.

promises.promise: This is the confidence we have in him: if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us. And if we know he hears us, we know we have what we asked of him.
promises.text: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us. And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
promises.context: He listens; we have what we asked.

promises.promise: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself. The evil one doesn’t touch him.
promises.text: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

promises.promise: For the truth’s sake, which remains in us. It will be with us forever: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
promises.text: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
promises.context: Grace, mercy, and peace; truth forever.

promises.promise: Beloved friend, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be in good health, just as your soul is getting along well.
promises.text: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
promises.context: Prosper and be healthy as soul prospers.

promises.promise: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, made holy by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ.
promises.text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

promises.promise: But you, beloved, build yourselves up in your most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit. Keep yourselves in God’s love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
promises.text: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit. Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
promises.context: Keep in God’s love; mercy to eternal life.

promises.promise: God is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you faultless before his glory with great joy. To him be glory forever.
promises.text: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy, to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
promises.context: Able to keep from stumbling; present faultless with joy.

promises.promise: Blessed is he who reads and people who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.
promises.text: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

promises.promise: Jesus Christ, those who trust him witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
promises.text: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood— and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
promises.context: Loves us; washed from sins; made us kingdom priests.

promises.promise: Jesus says, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last, the Living One. I was dead, and I am alive forever. I hold the keys of death and of Hades.”
promises.text: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last, and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
promises.context: Don’t fear; alive forever; keys of Death.

promises.promise: God promises that he who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes he will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.
promises.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.
promises.context: Overcome; eat from tree of life.

promises.promise: God promises that don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and he will give you the crown of life.
promises.text: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
promises.context: Faithful to death; crown of life.

promises.promise: God promises that anyone who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.
promises.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.
promises.context: Overcome; not harmed by second death.

promises.promise: God promises that to him who overcomes, he will give of the hidden manna, and he will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.
promises.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

promises.promise: God promises that he who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him he will give authority over the nations… and he will give him the morning star.
promises.text: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations. He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father; and I will give him the morning star.

promises.promise: God promises that he who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and he will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and he will confess his name before my Father and before his angels.
promises.text: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
promises.context: White garments; name in book of life.

promises.promise: God promises that i know your works. he has set before you an open door, which no one can shut, which you have, that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny his name.
promises.text: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.
promises.context: Open door no one can shut.

promises.promise: Because you kept Jesus’ call to endure, he promises to keep you through the hour of testing that is coming on the world.
promises.text: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
promises.context: Kept; will keep from hour of testing.

promises.promise: God says he is coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown. He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more.
promises.text: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown. He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
promises.context: A lasting place with God, marked by his name.

promises.promise: God promises that as many as I love, I rebuke and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent. I stand at the door and knock.
promises.text: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent. Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me. He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.
promises.context: Love rebukes; knock; dine; sit on throne.

promises.promise: You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation, and made us kings and priests to our God. And we will reign on the earth.
promises.text: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation, and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”
promises.context: Bought with blood; kings and priests; will reign.

promises.promise: John sees a great crowd from every nation standing before the throne and the Lamb, clothed in white, crying out that salvation belongs to God and to the Lamb.
promises.text: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands. They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
promises.context: Countless multitude; salvation to God and Lamb.

promises.promise: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them. They will never be hungry or thirsty any more.
promises.text: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them. They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat; for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

promises.promise: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”.
promises.text: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”
promises.context: Kingdom of world becomes Lord’s; reign forever.

promises.promise: Heaven announces salvation and God’s kingdom. Believers overcame the accuser by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony—they did not love their lives even to death.
promises.text: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night. They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.
promises.context: Accuser thrown down; overcome by Lamb’s blood.

promises.promise: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus. I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”.
promises.text: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.” I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”
promises.context: Blessed dead in the Lord; rest from labors.

promises.promise: God promises that i heard something like the voice of a great multitude… saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord God, the Almighty, reigns! Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him.
promises.text: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns! Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”
promises.context: Lord reigns; wedding of the Lamb.

promises.promise: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”.
promises.text: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

promises.promise: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ. Will reign with him one thousand years.
promises.text: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.
promises.context: First resurrection; second death no power; reign.

promises.promise: God promises that i saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more. I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
promises.text: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more. I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
promises.context: New heaven and earth; New Jerusalem.

promises.promise: God promises to live with his people. He will wipe away every tear. Death, pain, and crying will be gone forever.
promises.text: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God. He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
promises.context: God will live with his people and wipe away every tear.

promises.promise: God promises that he who sits on the throne said, “he is making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.” He said to me, “It is done! he is the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. he will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
promises.text: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.” He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life. He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.
promises.context: All things new; free water of life; my son.

promises.promise: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb. The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
promises.text: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb. The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it. Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),
promises.context: Glory illuminates; nations walk in light; no night.

promises.promise: They will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it. There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only people who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
promises.text: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter. There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
promises.context: Only those in Lamb’s book of life.

promises.promise: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb, in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month.
promises.text: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb, in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
promises.context: River of life; tree for healing of nations.

promises.promise: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him. They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
promises.text: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him. They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads. There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
promises.context: See his face; no night; reign forever.

promises.promise: God promises that he is coming quickly! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
promises.text: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
promises.context: Jesus is coming, and he brings reward.

promises.promise: God promises a real blessing: blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
promises.text: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
promises.context: A welcome into God’s city and life.

promises.promise: God promises that i, Jesus, have sent his angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. he is the root and the children of David, the Bright and Morning Star.
promises.text: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”

promises.promise: The Spirit and the church say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come. God offers the water of life freely to anyone who wants it.
promises.text: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.
promises.context: An open invitation to come to God.

promises.promise: God promises that he who testifies these things says, “Yes, he is coming quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
promises.text: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
promises.context: Jesus promises he is coming soon.
